comment_de: Kanonische, handgepflegte Vollständigkeitsquelle der Spezifikation. CI prüft: Registry × vorhandene Schema-/Vektor-/expected-Dateien = vollständige Matrix. Diese Datei ist der Maßstab — nicht die vorhandenen Dateien.
comment_en: Canonical, hand-maintained completeness source of the specification. CI checks: registry × existing schema/vector/expected files = complete matrix. This file is the yardstick — not the files that happen to exist.

types.comment_de: Grundtypen mit eigener Grammatik, die ab Fassung 1.10 als Registry-Typ benannt sind, und die Grammatik B64 (Format-Spezifikation Abschnitt 2). Die übrigen Typen beschreibt Abschnitt 2 wie bisher. Ein Feld vom Typ rfc3339 mit "fraction": "any" folgt der Grammatik aus Abschnitt 10.7.1 (Sekundenbruchteile beliebiger Länge oder keine); ohne diese Angabe gilt in den erzeugten Schemata genau die Form JJJJ-MM-TTThh:mm:ss.sssZ. Ein Feld vom Typ date mit "range": "log" liegt im Protokollbereich.
types.comment_en: Base types with their own grammar that are named as registry types from edition 1.10, and the grammar B64 (format spec section 2). Section 2 describes the other types as before. A field of type rfc3339 with "fraction": "any" follows the grammar of section 10.7.1 (fractional seconds of any length or none); without it the generated schemas require exactly the form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ. A field of type date with "range": "log" lies in the log range.

date.comment: calendar day YYYY-MM-DD in the ASCII digits 0 to 9; the date MUST exist in the proleptic Gregorian calendar, year 0001 to 9999 (a pattern cannot check existence, the reader does); spelled date in the spec tables

log_range.comment: members of the vendor log of type date (format spec 7.4) additionally lie in this range (Protokollbereich)

date.day_arithmetic: dn(d) = number of days from 0001-01-01 to d (dn(0001-01-01) = 0); end(d) = (dn(d) + 1) * 86400000, the end of the UTC day d in whole milliseconds since 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z; previous days, following days and day ends MUST be computed on these integers, never as calendar dates; day(ts) = the ten characters of an rfc3339 value before the T (fractions never change it)

key_id.comment: key identifier, the grammar of format spec 10.7.1 (key_id, wurzel_id, server_key_id, log_id); spelled key-id in the spec tables

b64.comment: grammar B64 (RFC 4648 section 4): only A-Z, a-z, 0-9, + and /, a length divisible by 4, = only as padding at the end and at most twice; line breaks, spaces and other characters violate B64; unused bits of the last group are not checked; a decoder that skips line breaks MUST refuse \r and \n first. It applies to token_base64 (format spec 7.3; a violation is TIME_ANCHOR_INVALID, not a format error, because the field keeps the registry type string), to the time stamps of day entries (7.4.6), to the content of a PEM block after joining its lines and to certificates in auditor files (10.8). It is a grammar, not a field type

printable_ascii_statements.comment: the statement_jcs of a day entry (vendor_log.day_entry) and of an anchor history page of kind v2 (cloud_statements.anchor_history_v2) consists only of the bytes 0x20 to 0x7E; its length limit in characters is therefore also one in bytes

mono_delta_ms.comment: monotonic ms since previous entry; -1 = unknown (first entry after process start)

prev_hash.comment: entry_hash of previous entry; seq=1: 64 zeros

entry_hash.comment: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS of the entry WITHOUT the entry_hash field

narrowed.comment: machine-readable form of the 1.8 rule below, bound to the entry's OWN spec_version (10.6 rule 3); the generated entry schema carries it as if/then

license_id.comment: licence commitment: from spec 1.8 it MUST be the lowercase hex SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the licence key (the value of cloud_messages.activation.license_commitment), exactly 64 characters [0-9a-f]; a GENESIS whose own spec_version is 1.8 or newer with any other value is FORMAT_ERROR (format spec 4.1, 10.6 rule 3). Up to 1.7 the content was undefined and the standard installation wrote the licence key in cleartext: for such a GENESIS the verifier prints a notice (no finding) and never the value

purpose_statement.comment: declared system purpose from onboarding; descriptive evidence for purpose-limitation tile

predecessor_chain.comment: emergency chain succession; null for a first chain

confidence.comment: recorded = captured by proxy; claimed = asserted by provider/import source

source_id.comment: import source identifier; null for proxy

source_ref.comment: id inside the source for idempotency

request_commitment.comment: HMAC-SHA-256(salt, request plaintext); salt stored with vault object

started_ts.comment: start of the window, inclusive, appliance wall clock; may lie before the last entry before the silence; after a crash no later than the capture safe point and the ts_captured of answered calls written but not durable (format spec 4.4, 8.7)

ended_ts.comment: end of the window, inclusive, appliance wall clock (format spec 4.4)

downtime_ms_estimate.comment: -1 = unknown; from ts_chained of the last surviving entry of the previous process to this RESTART, not from the start of a following GAP window (format spec 4.9, 8.7)

reason.comment: export (from spec 1.9): export seal - the running installation seals the chain for a verification package and the same writer continues it immediately with RESUME (format spec 4.10, 8.4, 8.6); a verifier up to 1.8 reports it as FORMAT_ERROR (closed enum, 10.6 rule 3)

sealed_entry_hash.comment: entry_hash of the SEAL entry this RESUME continues from

reference.comment: what is being decided; e.g. chain seq, case id

value_commitment.comment: commitment of new value where the value itself is sensitive

step_id.comment: onboarding step id for duration measurement

signature_by_old_key.comment: Ed25519 by old key over JCS({old_key_id,new_key_id,new_pubkey})

pdf_hash.comment: null when Chromium unavailable and only HTML was produced

payload_canonical.comment: the exact JCS bytes sent to the vendor, verbatim

tree_size.comment: number of leaves covered, i.e. all entries with seq < this entry's seq

prev_checkpoint_hash.comment: entry_hash of previous CHECKPOINT entry; 64 zeros for the first

signature.comment: Ed25519 by device key over JCS({chain_id,tree_size,merkle_root,prev_checkpoint_hash,key_id,ts}) with ts = ts_chained of this entry

checkpoint_seq.comment: seq of the CHECKPOINT the token attests

tsa_name.comment: authority as configured by the customer; informational

tsa_policy.comment: TSTInfo.policy OID; MUST equal the token

tsa_serial.comment: TSTInfo.serialNumber, lowercase hex; MUST equal the token (checked against the token, not by pattern)

tsa_ts.comment: TSTInfo.genTime cut (not rounded) to milliseconds; MUST equal the token (format spec 7.3 step 3)

token_base64.comment: DER TimeStampToken (RFC 3161), base64; DER MUST NOT exceed 16384 bytes

target_seq.comment: seq of the AI_CALL whose capture was cut

request_bytes_captured.comment: bytes of the request the capture (commitment, vault) covers

response_bytes_captured.comment: bytes of the response the capture covers

scope_from.comment: earliest ts_captured covered; unbounded: 0001-01-01T00:00:00.000Z (compared as a point in time)

scope_to.comment: latest ts_captured covered; unbounded: 9999-12-31T23:59:59.000Z (compared as a point in time)

DATA_ACCESS.comment: format spec 4.25 (from edition 1.10): a recorded access by a person or a service to customer data of a vendor in the sense of heartbeat spec 12 (access chain); no free text, no customer identifier, no name, no content of the data; written only by an access chain (heartbeat spec 12), never by the chain of a customer's appliance; not critical, no finding, covers no silence (8.2), not counted in residual windows or covered stretches (11.2), not read by the evidence level (10.9); a verifier of edition 1.9 reports it as UNKNOWN_ENTRY_TYPE (10.6 rule 2) and checks the chain otherwise in full

access_id.comment: identifier of the access; an access spanning several data classes carries the same access_id in each of its entries

actor_id.comment: account in the operator's account directory; a uuid cannot carry a name; every addition to the directory stands beforehand as an entry of its own (data_class credentials, access_mode change, purpose maintenance, scope all_customers) whose case record is the addition (heartbeat spec 12, access chain, item 4)

purpose.comment: service is the standing purpose of a service, recorded once per start of the service and per data class; only a part whose output no person reads directly counts as a service, every other part is an access path and writes one entry per access (heartbeat spec 12, access chain, item 1); other refers to the case record

data_class.comment: follows the list 'Was der Hersteller hält' of heartbeat spec 12; chain includes the data of the vendor log and openings of fillers (format spec 7.4.13); access_chain is the access chain itself with its case records and salts (heartbeat spec 12), e.g. when an audit reads it; store is the whole data store (the file of a database, access to a machine); other is a class the case record names

record_commitment.comment: Hex(HMAC-SHA-256(key = salt, message = case record)), salt 32 random bytes per case record; record and salt stay with the operator, never in the chain; the verifier does not check it (no evidence produced by LEDGER for the content of the record)

capture.comment: gate: written by an access path through an import interface (origin import) before it released data (format spec 8.7); declared: entered by a person (origin portal); emergency: an access path released data without confirmation because the access chain was unreachable, and the person entered the access afterwards (origin portal)

DATA_ACCESS.example_comment: record_commitment = HMAC-SHA-256(key = SHA-256 of the ASCII bytes LEDGER-BEISPIEL-SALZ-VORGANG-1, message = the ASCII bytes {"access":"example"})

truncate.de: Kürzen der Kette gegen verankerte Roots
truncate.en: truncating the chain against anchored roots

silent_gap.en: concealed silence without a covering GAP

vendor_omission.de: Weglassen einer ausgestellten Gegensignatur im Herstellerprotokoll oder in der Anker-Historie durch den Hersteller
vendor_omission.en: the vendor omitting a countersignature it issued from the vendor log or the anchor history

vendor_split_view.de: verschiedene Fassungen von Herstellerprotokoll oder Anker-Historie für verschiedene Prüfer
vendor_split_view.en: different versions of the vendor log or the anchor history for different auditors

collusion.de: Zusammenwirken von Hersteller und Kunde, etwa bei einem verbundenen Kunden
collusion.en: vendor and customer acting together, for example with an affiliated customer

MERKLE_INCONSISTENT.en: Merkle consistency between anchored roots violated

TIME_ANCHOR_INVALID.de: Zeitzeuge widerspricht dem Checkpoint oder ist gefälscht
TIME_ANCHOR_INVALID.en: time witness contradicts the checkpoint or is forged

CLOCK_ANOMALY.en: time contradiction without a chained CLOCK_JUMP

CONCEALED_SILENCE.de: Stille im Kettenverlauf ohne deckenden GAP/RESTART

MISSING_CHECKPOINT.de: kritischer Eintrag ohne unmittelbar folgenden Checkpoint
MISSING_CHECKPOINT.en: critical entry without an immediately following checkpoint

REPORT_MISMATCH.de: vorgelegter Bericht nicht in der Kette
REPORT_MISMATCH.en: presented report not in the chain

UNSEALED_END.en: chain ends without a seal: incomplete (section 8.6)

CONTENT_DELETED.en: content deleted per retention, chain intact

HOLD_VIOLATION.en: content deleted despite an active deletion hold (section 9.3)

TRAILING_SILENCE.en: chain ends before the freshness window

TIME_ANCHOR_UNVERIFIED.de: Zeitzeuge vorhanden, seine Stelle aber nicht unabhängig belegt
TIME_ANCHOR_UNVERIFIED.en: time witness present, its authority not independently established

RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED.de: Hersteller-Gegensignatur stimmig, ihr Schlüssel aber nicht durch einen Vertrauensanker des Prüfers belegt
RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED.en: vendor countersignature consistent, but its key is not established by a trust anchor of the auditor

VENDOR_LOG_UNVERIFIED.de: Herstellerprotokoll übergeben, aber nicht durch Anker des Prüfers belegt oder nicht vollständig übergeben
VENDOR_LOG_UNVERIFIED.en: vendor log supplied but not established by the auditor's anchors, or not supplied completely

VENDOR_LOG_DEFECTIVE.de: übergebenes Herstellerprotokoll trägt nicht (Signatur, Zeitstempel oder Nachweis)
VENDOR_LOG_DEFECTIVE.en: supplied vendor log material does not hold (signature, time stamp or proof)

VENDOR_LOG_CONTRADICTION.de: Hersteller hat einander widersprechende oder regelwidrige Protokollaussagen signiert
VENDOR_LOG_CONTRADICTION.en: the vendor signed contradicting or rule-breaking log statements

RECEIPT_NOT_LOGGED.de: Quittung fehlt im bezeugten Herstellerprotokoll ihres Tages
RECEIPT_NOT_LOGGED.en: receipt missing from the witnessed vendor log of its day

LOGGED_ROOT_MISMATCH.de: im Herstellerprotokoll festgehaltene Wurzel passt nicht zum Paket
LOGGED_ROOT_MISMATCH.en: root recorded in the vendor log does not match the package

ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED.de: Anker-Historie übergeben, für dieses Paket aber nicht belegt (Schlüssel nicht durch einen Anker des Prüfers belegt oder nicht gültig, andere Art, andere Kette, anderes Gerät, vor der Anforderung ausgestellt oder unvollständig übergeben)
ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED.en: anchor history supplied but not established for this package (key not established by an anchor of the auditor or not valid, other kind, other chain, other device, issued before the request or supplied incompletely)

ANCHOR_HISTORY_DEFECTIVE.de: Signatur einer übergebenen Seite der Anker-Historie trägt nicht
ANCHOR_HISTORY_DEFECTIVE.en: the signature of a supplied anchor history page does not hold

ANCHOR_HISTORY_CONTRADICTION.de: Hersteller hat regelwidrige oder einander widersprechende Aussagen zur Anker-Historie dieser Kette signiert (Seiten untereinander, Quittungen, Herstellerprotokoll)
ANCHOR_HISTORY_CONTRADICTION.en: the vendor signed rule-breaking or contradicting statements on the anchor history of this chain (pages among themselves, receipts, vendor log)

ANCHOR_HISTORY_FORK.de: Anker-Historie zeigt eine zweite Fassung dieser Kette oder ihrer Nachfolge (Fork-Befund, abweichende Wurzel, Wurzel hinter der Übergabe)
ANCHOR_HISTORY_FORK.en: anchor history shows a second version of this chain or of its succession (fork finding, differing root, root beyond the handover)

SPEC_NEWER.de: Paket nutzt eine neuere Minor-Version der Spezifikation als der Verifier
SPEC_NEWER.en: package uses a newer minor version of the specification than the verifier

UNKNOWN_ENTRY_TYPE.de: Eintragstyp dieser Verifier-Version unbekannt; Eintrag geprueft, Nutzlast nicht
UNKNOWN_ENTRY_TYPE.en: entry type unknown to this verifier version; entry checked, payload not

UNKNOWN_MANIFEST_FIELD.de: Manifest-Feld dieser Verifier-Version unbekannt; angenommen und gemeldet, alle bekannten Prüfungen laufen weiter
UNKNOWN_MANIFEST_FIELD.en: manifest field unknown to this verifier version; accepted and reported, all known checks still run

timestamp_profile.comment_de: Zeitstempelprofil (Format-Spezifikation 7.5, ab Fassung 1.10): wie ein Verifier einen Zeitstempel nach RFC 3161 liest und prüft, für die Zeitzeugen der Kette (7.3), die Zeitstempel der Tageseinträge des Herstellerprotokolls (7.4.6) und die Bedingungen der Beweisstufe (10.9). Das Ergebnis hängt allein von diesen Regeln ab, nicht von einer Zertifikatsbibliothek. Ein Profil für Zeitzeugen und Protokoll gemeinsam, mit RSASSA-PSS, P-521 und Ed25519; beide Referenz-Verifier setzen es vollständig um, einschließlich der Schritte 5 und 6.
timestamp_profile.comment_en: Time-stamp profile (format spec 7.5, from edition 1.10): how a verifier reads and checks an RFC 3161 time stamp, for the time witnesses of the chain (7.3), the time stamps of the vendor log's day entries (7.4.6) and the conditions of the evidence level (10.9). The result depends on these rules alone, not on a certificate library. One profile for time witnesses and log alike, with RSASSA-PSS, P-521 and Ed25519; both reference verifiers implement it completely, including steps 5 and 6.

1.rule: checkpoint_seq names a CHECKPOINT whose tree_size and merkle_root equal the entry's

2.rule: token_base64 follows B64, the decoded DER has at most 16384 bytes, the token follows grammar T

3.rule: the three readings tsa_policy, tsa_serial and tsa_ts equal the token (the imprint algorithm has no member in the entry and is used in step 4); tsa_ts equals genTime truncated (not rounded) to milliseconds; its form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ is already checked by the payload schema (another form is FORMAT_ERROR); a genTime with fractional seconds is allowed

4.rule: the token's messageImprint equals H(JCS(signing subject of the referenced checkpoint)) with the token's own algorithm

5a.rule: performability: signed attributes and certificates present, every element of certificates satisfies Z.1, the signer is found exactly once (Z.5), the signer's digest and signature algorithm and key lie in Z.2 and fit each other
5a.else: TIME_ANCHOR_UNVERIFIED (exit 1, with the reason), never exit 2

5b.rule: contentType names id-ct-TSTInfo, messageDigest is the hash of eContent under the signer's digestAlgorithm, the signature holds over the DER of signedAttrs with tag 0x31 instead of 0xA0 (RFC 5652 section 5.4)

6.rule: the signer certificate chains after Z.3 and Z.4 at genTime to a root of purpose chain that the auditor supplies (the system root store never counts, and no verifier carries a built-in root of a time-stamping authority) and carries exactly the extended key usage id-kp-timeStamping, marked critical

timestamp_profile.steps_1_to_4_present_anchor: a TIME_ANCHOR that passes steps 1 to 4 counts as present external anchoring (no NO_ANCHOR), also when step 6 fails

T.1.rule: ContentInfo SEQUENCE { contentType, content [0] EXPLICIT SignedData }, no bytes after it and nothing after content inside it

T.2.rule: digestAlgorithms SET OF AlgorithmIdentifier; certificates [0] IMPLICIT OPTIONAL (content checked in step 5); crls [1] IMPLICIT OPTIONAL (only the TLV is read); exactly one SignerInfo

T.3.rule: eContent [0] EXPLICIT OCTET STRING is present and holds exactly one TSTInfo without trailing bytes

T.4.rule: digestAlgorithm parameters absent or NULL and listed in digestAlgorithms (whose elements also carry no parameters or NULL); signatureAlgorithm parameters a TLV or absent (checked in step 5); unsignedAttrs only read as TLV; if signedAttrs are present, every attribute is SEQUENCE { attrType OID, attrValues SET OF } with at least one value, exactly one contentType with exactly one OID value and exactly one messageDigest with exactly one OCTET STRING value

T.5.gen_time: GeneralizedTime YYYYMMDDhhmmss[.f]Z with 1 to 9 digits f whose last is not 0, an existing date, hour 00 to 23, minute and second 00 to 59, no offset
T.5.rule: TSTInfo SEQUENCE { version, policy, messageImprint, serialNumber, genTime, accuracy OPTIONAL, ordering OPTIONAL, nonce OPTIONAL, tsa [0] EXPLICIT OPTIONAL, extensions [1] IMPLICIT OPTIONAL } in this order and nothing else; sha1 and every other algorithm violate T; tsa is a TLV; the content of extensions is read only by rule QS

T.6.rule: DER for every element: definite lengths in minimal form, INTEGER with at least one content octet in minimal two's complement, BOOLEAN with content 00 or FF, OID with at least one content octet and every subidentifier minimal and complete, primitive or constructed form as the type requires; the order inside a SET OF is not checked; an explicitly encoded DEFAULT value is accepted; where the grammar asks for one TLV (tsa, crls, unsignedAttrs, the value of a signed attribute no rule reads, the value of an attribute in a Name, the parameters of signatureAlgorithm and of every other AlgorithmIdentifier no rule reads, extnValue of an extension no rule reads, the parts of issuerSerial and policies that Z.6 names) only that outer TLV is checked; a content checked without a grammar (the four extensions read under Z.1) is checked in every element and in every constructed element of any class, the universal class constructed exactly for tag numbers 8, 11, 16, 17 and 29 and primitive for every other from 1 to 30, a universal element with tag number 0 or from 31 on violates T.6 there; not checked: zero unused bits of a BIT STRING and content rules of X.690 other than those named

z1_certificates.applies_to: every element of certificates and every certificate the auditor supplies
z1_certificates.rule: Certificate SEQUENCE { tbsCertificate, signatureAlgorithm, signatureValue BIT STRING with 0 unused bits }, DER after T.6, no trailing bytes; no issuerUniqueID or subjectUniqueID; serialNumber positive; tbsCertificate.signature byte-identical to the outer signatureAlgorithm; subjectPublicKeyInfo BIT STRING with 0 unused bits; Names compared as bytes, never interpreted; Time is UTCTime YYMMDDhhmmssZ (YY < 50 is 20YY, else 19YY) or GeneralizedTime YYYYMMDDhhmmssZ with valid date and time; Extension critical, if encoded, 00 or FF; no extnID twice; extnValue exactly one DER TLV; for basicConstraints, keyUsage, extKeyUsage and subjectKeyIdentifier the content of extnValue is read and MUST be DER after T.6, a violation makes the certificate violate Z.1

rsa.pkcs1_v1_5: comparison of the complete encoded message, signature length equal to the octet length of n
rsa.pss: exactly { [0] hashAlgorithm SHA-2, [1] maskGenAlgorithm MGF1 with the same hash, [2] saltLength = hash length, [3] trailerField absent or 1 } on an rsaEncryption key
rsa.signer_info_only: rsaEncryption together with a SHA-2 digestAlgorithm

ecdsa.point: uncompressed 04 || X || Y on the curve
ecdsa.signature_value: SEQUENCE { r, s } of minimal positive INTEGERs with 1 <= r, s < group order
ecdsa.signer_info_only: id-ecPublicKey together with a SHA-2 digestAlgorithm

eddsa.key: id-Ed25519 without parameters, 32 octets, canonical y; verified as every Ed25519 signature of the specification (section 2): without cofactor, S < L, k = SHA-512(R, A as written, M) mod L, the encoding of [S]B - [k]A equal to R byte for byte

z3_extensions.rule: the three understood extensions are read also when marked critical: basicConstraints SEQUENCE { cA BOOLEAN OPTIONAL, pathLenConstraint INTEGER (0..MAX) OPTIONAL }, keyUsage BIT STRING with at least one content octet, the first (the number of unused bits) 0 to 7 and 0 if no further octet follows, a bit such as keyCertSign (bit 5) set only if it lies among the used bits and is 1, extKeyUsage SEQUENCE SIZE (1..MAX) OF OID; one of them not following this grammar makes the path unusable at every position, c0 included; a certificate of the path with one of the path_unusable extensions, critical or not, or with any other critical extension makes this path unusable; any other non-critical extension is passed over

z4_path.time: genTime of the token, compared as instants
not_checked: keyUsage of the signer beyond its grammar under Z.3
z4_path.rule: a path c0 (signer) ... ck with ck byte-identical (DER) to the root, 0 <= k <= 8, no certificate twice, intermediates only from the token's certificates; issuer(ci) byte-identical to subject(ci+1) and the signature of ci holds under the key of ci+1 after Z.2; every cj with j >= 1 carries basicConstraints cA TRUE, keyUsage (if present) with keyCertSign and pathLenConstraint (if present) >= j - 1; every certificate of the path has notBefore <= genTime <= notAfter; existence over all candidates up to depth 8, so the search order cannot change the result

z5_signer.rule: sid as IssuerAndSerialNumber matches the issuer bytes and serialNumber value of a certificate (serialNumber an INTEGER per T.6), as [0] the key identifier of its subjectKeyIdentifier extension (the content of the OCTET STRING in its extnValue); exactly one certificate of certificates matches (equal bytes count once); signed are the DER bytes of signedAttrs with tag 0x31 instead of 0xA0

z6_ess.v1_cert_hash: sha1 of the signer certificate DER, an identifier, not an imprint
z6_ess.rule: the signed attributes hold at least one of signingCertificate and signingCertificateV2; each appears at most once with at most one value (T.4 already requires one), a SigningCertificate(V2) in DER per T.6 with at least one element in certs; read is SEQUENCE { certs SEQUENCE OF ESSCertID(v2), policies OPTIONAL } with ESSCertID { certHash, issuerSerial OPTIONAL }, ESSCertIDv2 { hashAlgorithm OPTIONAL, certHash, issuerSerial OPTIONAL } and IssuerSerial { GeneralNames, serialNumber }; every element of certs follows this grammar, only certs[0] is compared; in GeneralNames an element with identifier octet A4 holds exactly one Name per Z.1, of every other element and of policies only the outer TLV is checked; a [4] elsewhere is no directoryName; the hashAlgorithm of an ESSCertIDv2 is recognised by its OID alone, its parameters one TLV or absent; each one present names the signer certificate in certs[0].certHash; issuerSerial in certs[0], if present, matches the signer; a token with both attributes is admissible; any deviation, also in a later element of certs, violates Z.6 (never grammar T, never step 5b)
z6_ess.issuer_serial: issuerSerial in certs[0] matches the signer if its serialNumber equals the signer's and the Name in one directoryName [4] among its GeneralNames is byte-identical with the signer's issuer; an issuerSerial in a later element is not compared
z6_ess.effect: condition for a confirmed day token (7.4.6) and for condition 4 of the evidence level; it never changes the finding of a TIME_ANCHOR
z6_ess.not_checkable: a present signingCertificateV2 whose hashAlgorithm is other than sha256, sha384 or sha512 is not compared and does not by itself violate Z.6; if the token does not violate Z.6 otherwise, Z.6 cannot be checked: the day token is unconfirmed and condition 4 gets signature_not_checkable; never defective

qs.rule: input is the [1] extensions of TSTInfo or none. 1: no [1]: absent. 2: the content of [1] is one or more Extension after Z.1, each DER after T.6 without trailing bytes; critical, if encoded, exactly one content octet 00 or FF, an explicitly encoded 00 is accepted; any other content octet, an empty [1], a duplicate extnID or any other deviation: unusable; of extnValue this item checks only the outer TLV, so content of the qcStatements extnValue that is not DER is malformed under item 4, not unusable. 3: an extension with critical FF whose extnID is not the qcStatements OID: unusable. 4: no qcStatements extension: absent; else its extnValue MUST be exactly one DER SEQUENCE OF QCStatement, each SEQUENCE { statementId OID, statementInfo ANY OPTIONAL } with one or two elements, no trailing bytes, else malformed; present iff one statementId is the statement_id, else absent; statementInfo is not evaluated. The rule never yields a finding and is never part of steps 1 to 6

outcomes.comment: signing_certificate_not_bound only for condition 4; for condition 7 a defective day time stamp forms no triple
a signingCertificateV2 with a hash outside sha256, sha384, sha512 and no violation; condition 4 only

timestamp_profile.outcomes_comment: format spec 7.5.7 in table order: time_anchor null = no effect on the exit code; day_token null = no effect; evidence_level [] = no credit. A day token is judged by the rows in this order, the topmost that applies decides, and it is confirmed if none applies; a TIME_ANCHOR follows the order of the steps of 7.3

chain.de: Zeitzeugen der Kette (7.3 Schritt 6) und Bedingung 1 der Beweisstufe
chain.en: time witnesses of the chain (7.3 step 6) and condition 1 of the evidence level

qualified.de: Bedingung 4 der Beweisstufe, nur im Zeitraum, für den der Prüfer die Wurzel als qualifiziert benennt; eine solche Wurzel trägt zugleich den Zweck chain; trägt dasselbe Zertifikat auch den Zweck log, zählt es im selben Zeitraum für Bedingung 7, den zweiten Weg zu Stufe 3
qualified.en: condition 4 of the evidence level, only within the period for which the auditor names the root as qualified; such a root also carries the purpose chain; if the same certificate also carries the purpose log, it counts within the same period for condition 7, the second way to level 3

log.de: Zeitstempel der Tageseinträge des Herstellerprotokolls (7.4.6) und, zusammen mit dem Zweck qualified an derselben Wurzel, die Bedingung 7 der Beweisstufe, den zweiten Weg zu Stufe 3
log.en: time stamps of the vendor log's day entries (7.4.6) and, together with the purpose qualified on the same root, condition 7 of the evidence level, the second way to level 3

timestamp_profile.root_purposes_rule: a root counts only for the purposes for which the auditor supplies it; a root for the log never confirms a time witness of the chain and vice versa; the file of qualified roots never gives the purpose log, so for condition 7 the auditor passes the same certificate also as a root for the log (format spec 10.8); the system root store counts for no purpose, and no verifier carries a built-in root of a time-stamping authority
timestamp_profile.root_table: every certificate from the three root inputs (auditor_inputs) is one entry with its SPKI SHA-256 value and its purposes; byte-equal certificates (DER) from several inputs are one entry with the union of their purposes; the period for the purpose qualified comes only from the file ledger-tsa-qualifiziert/1, which never gives the purpose log; the system root store adds nothing, and no verifier carries a built-in root of a time-stamping authority

timestamp_profile.published_test_keys_comment: keys whose private part is published or can be derived from published values (format spec 7.5.7); two kinds of entries: spki_sha256 (keys of time-stamping authorities: a signer or root with such a key confirms nothing and is credited for no condition) and ed25519 (from 1.10, test keys of the vendor in the test corpus: vendor root, countersigning keys, statements keys, the update manifest key and the protocol keys vendor-log-test-001 and vendor-log-test-002 of the test log; they count under the usual rules and give the note published_test_key_credited); a time-stamping authority of the test corpus with discarded keys (format spec 7.5.7) is not listed; the list names keys, never customers or vendors, and changes only with an edition of the specification

key_roles.comment_de: Rollenprüfung (Format-Spezifikation 10.7.4, ab Fassung 1.10): welche Schlüssel des Herstellers in welcher Rolle belegt sind. Sie läuft mit Schritt L1 vor der Prüfung der Quittungen (10.5, Schritt 4), liest die Liste der Gegenzeichnungsschlüssel des Pakets und die Listen und Anheftungen des Prüfers und fügt keine Befundklasse hinzu; ein Widerspruch der Rollen endet bei Exit 1 über bestehende Klassen, nie bei Exit 2. Verglichen wird der Publikey, nicht die key_id.
key_roles.comment_en: Role check (format spec 10.7.4, from edition 1.10): which vendor keys are established in which role. It runs with step L1 before the receipts are checked (10.5, step 4), reads the package's list of countersigning keys and the auditor's lists and pins, and adds no finding class; a contradiction of roles ends at exit 1 through existing classes, never at exit 2. The public key is compared, not the key_id.
key_roles.reason_rule: null for not_supplied and effective; for not_effective lists_contradictory or key_in_two_roles where they apply, else the reason of the candidate that came furthest, in the order format, no_matching_root, signature

format.en: the role list violates the format

no_matching_root.de: keine Herstellerwurzel des Prüfers mit der wurzel_id der Rollenliste
no_matching_root.en: no vendor root of the auditor with the role list's wurzel_id

signature.en: the role list's signature does not hold

key_in_two_roles.de: Schlüssel in zwei Rollen des Herstellers
key_in_two_roles.en: a key in two roles of the vendor

unknown_role.de: Die Rollenliste nennt eine Rolle, die diese Fassung nicht kennt; ein solcher Eintrag belegt nichts.
unknown_role.en: The role list names a role this edition does not know; such an entry establishes nothing.

receipt_key_other_role.de: Eine Quittung nennt im Manifest einen Schlüssel einer anderen Rolle; er belegt keine Quittung.
receipt_key_other_role.en: A receipt names in the manifest a key of another role; it establishes no receipt.

pin_dropped.de: Eine Anheftung nennt einen Publikey, den eine Liste mit einer anderen Rolle nennt; sie belegt nichts.
pin_dropped.en: A pin names a public key that a list names with another role; it establishes nothing.

note_occasions.unknown_role: the effective role list Q has an entry whose rolle is not among key_role_list.roles
note_occasions.receipt_key_other_role: a receipt not established after format spec 7.1 whose public key in the manifest is an entry of Q with another role, a key of P, or a statements or protocol pin

unusable_invocation: a statements pin not of the form key_id=hex64
two statements pins with the same key_id and different public keys
a pin of one role equal in key_id or public key to a pin of another role (--vendor-key, --vendor-log-key, --vendor-statement-key)
a grammar or size violation of a file from --vendor-key-list, an unknown or a missing format included
key_roles.content_defects: a defect in the content of a list that keeps its grammar is never exit 3

terms.K_cs^L: the keys of the package's list of countersigning keys, if it is effective (format spec 10.7.1), and the keys of the effective lists of this format that the auditor passes
terms.P: the effective protocol key list after format spec 7.4.10, L1 item 2
terms.K_cs: K_cs^L together with the countersigning pins that are not dropped (format spec 7.4.10)

steps.R1: candidates are the distinct role lists (distinct by their JCS bytes) from --vendor-key-list; a candidate counts if it meets format spec 10.7.2 and its signature holds against a vendor root of the auditor or the built-in root with that wurzel_id; the report names the source of the root
steps.R2: Q is the counting candidate with the largest version; there is no Q (reason lists_contradictory) if two counting candidates have the same version and different bytes, if a counting candidate lacks an entry (the same key_id with the same pubkey and the same rolle) of a counting candidate of a smaller version, or if counting candidates carry different values of ende_doppelbetrieb or a candidate of a larger version lacks the member a candidate of a smaller version carries; values of ende_doppelbetrieb are compared as strings (the vendor copies the value character for character into every later version); if there is no Q, no candidate of a smaller version takes its place
steps.R3: by public key, in this order: (a) Q gives a public key of K_cs^L a role other than countersigning: Q is not effective (key_in_two_roles), there is no Q, no candidate of a smaller version takes its place, and (b) to (d) do not read this Q; (b) Q and P share a public key: neither is effective (key_in_two_roles; for P the reason key_in_two_roles of vendor_log.no_protocol_key_reasons); (c) P shares a public key with a countersigning pin or with K_cs^L: P is not effective (format spec 7.4.10, L1 item 3); (d) pins, checked against the then effective Q and P: a countersigning pin whose public key Q names with another role is dropped; a statements pin whose public key is in K_cs^L or P, or which Q names with another role, is dropped; a protocol pin whose public key is in K_cs^L or which Q names is dropped
steps.R4: countersigning: format spec 7.1 with the remaining pins, Q never establishes a receipt; statements: the statements pins first, then the entries of Q with rolle statements (format spec 8.8.3), a page under an entry with widerrufen_ab counts only if it is fresh (8.8.4, H2); protocol: format spec 7.4.10, L1; update_manifest and unknown roles: not used by the verifier; a page under a statements pin whose public key Q names with rolle statements and widerrufen_ab counts only if it is fresh (format spec 8.8.3, 8.8.4 H2 number 9)

key_roles.order_in_run: with step L1 before the receipts (format spec 10.5, step 4)
key_roles.key_ids_not_compared: each key is looked up only in its role; an equal key_id alone is no role conflict
key_roles.receipts: the findings after format spec 7.1 do not change; a receipt not established after 7.1 whose public key in the manifest is a key of another role is judged as in edition 1.9 (RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED when the manifest names the key), with the note receipt_key_other_role, and has the origin manifest for evidence-level condition receipt_key_confirmed; a dropped countersigning pin counts as not passed
key_roles.findings: no new finding class; exit 3 only for the unusable invocation above; a contradiction of roles ends at exit 1: ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED with key_not_established or key_other_role (8.8.4), VENDOR_LOG_UNVERIFIED with key_in_two_roles (7.4.10), RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED (7.1); RECEIPT_INVALID (exit 2) stays only where the package's list of countersigning keys contradicts a receipt (7.1)
reference_values: a countersigning pin with the public key of vendor-test-001 is effective next to the role list of key_role_list.example; a countersigning pin with the public key of vendor-statements-test-001 is dropped and establishes no receipt

a role list that gives the public key of vendor-test-001 the rolle statements is, in the package valid_vendor_list under testwurzel-1 (the package's list of countersigning keys effective, vendor-test-001 in K_cs^L), not effective (key_in_two_roles), and receipts are judged as without it

the same role list without an effective list of countersigning keys, with only --vendor-key for vendor-test-001: Q is effective, the pin is dropped (pins_dropped), and the receipts under vendor-test-001 give RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED with the note receipt_key_other_role
a role list with an unknown rolle is effective, with the note unknown_role
a statements pin equal to a countersigning pin is an unusable invocation
two counting role lists with ende_doppelbetrieb 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z and 2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z: lists_contradictory

the role list of the largest version not effective after R3 (a): no Q, even if a role list of a smaller version counts; a protocol key list that shares a public key only with this role list stays effective
a page whose server_key_id is the key_id of a dropped pin gives key_not_established, not key_other_role (format spec 8.8.4 H2 number 1)

at 2026-01-01T01:02:00.000Z vendor-statements-test-001 and vendor-statements-test-002 are established and valid by the role list of key_role_list.example; a page under vendor-test-001 gives key_other_role; a key the role list does not name gives key_not_established; a statements pin has precedence over the role list; two role lists of version 1 with different bytes: no Q (lists_contradictory), and no page is established through a role list (format spec 8.8.3)

anchor_history.comment_de: Anker-Historie als Angabe des Prüfers (Format-Spezifikation 8.8, ab Fassung 1.10): Gründe, Hinweise, Vollständigkeit und Stichtag. Gelesen werden nur Seiten der Form ledger.anchor_history.v2; die Verbundenheit leitet der Verifier nie aus dem Paket ab.
anchor_history.comment_en: Anchor history as an auditor input (format spec 8.8, from edition 1.10): reasons, notes, completeness and cut-off date. Only pages of kind ledger.anchor_history.v2 are read; the verifier never derives the affiliation from the package.
anchor_history.page_keys: format spec 8.8.3: a page of kind v2 carries the signature of a statements key; for its server_key_id, in this order: 1. a statements pin (--vendor-statement-key) not dropped after format spec 10.7.4 gives the pinned public key, without validity window, but if the effective role list names the same public key with rolle statements and widerrufen_ab, H2 number 9 still applies; 2. else the entry of the effective role list (verifier.key_roles, Q) with rolle statements; else the key is not established; a countersigning key, a protocol key and a key of another role never establish a page, neither through a pin after format spec 7.1 nor through a list of countersigning keys; the manifest copy (manifest.vendor_pubkeys, keys/vendor/<key_id>.hex) never establishes a page
anchor_history.w_h_comment: the band of 15 minutes: a page is fresh if server_ts >= R - W_h; a history root first recorded before R - W_h that the package lacks or contradicts is MERKLE_INCONSISTENT (exit 2)
anchor_history.time_arithmetic: whole milliseconds (format spec 2), R included; only the validity window of a role list entry (H2 item 6) is checked on nanoseconds as in format spec 7.1
anchor_history.legacy_boundary_comment: one value for every vendor, never a member of a page: receipts whose server_ts lies before it are counted as before_legacy_boundary (H10), because up to edition 1.9 the specification did not require the vendor to keep recorded roots permanently; to be confirmed from production

key_not_established.de: Schlüssel nicht durch einen Anker des Prüfers belegt
key_not_established.en: key not established by an anchor of the auditor

key_other_role.de: Schlüssel einer anderen Rolle des Herstellers; er belegt keine Seite
key_other_role.en: key of another role of the vendor; it establishes no page

page_rules.de: signierte Seite verletzt das Format oder eine Seitenregel
page_rules.en: signed page violates the format or a page rule

not_v2.en: not a page of kind ledger.anchor_history.v2

key_not_valid.de: Schlüssel zum Ausstellzeitpunkt der Seite nicht gültig
key_not_valid.en: key not valid at the issue time of the page

owner_differs.de: Seite gehört zu einem anderen Gerät als dieses Paket
owner_differs.en: page belongs to another device than this package

signing_time_not_proven.de: widerrufener Schlüssel, Ausstellzeitpunkt der Seite nicht belegt
signing_time_not_proven.en: revoked key, issue time of the page not proven

anchor_history.older_pages: a used page of the package that is not fresh enters the roots (H6), the comparison (H5, H7, H10) and a statement affiliated (H12), never the coverage (H4), the completeness (H11) or a statement not_affiliated
anchor_history.multiplicity: one finding per class and reason, with the count and the earliest occurrence; MERKLE_INCONSISTENT, fork_listed, history_root_differs and reported_root_beyond_package once per (t, r); log_mismatch once per day

requested_at_unused.de: Anforderungszeitpunkt ohne Anker-Historie übergeben; er wird nicht verwendet.
requested_at_unused.en: Request time supplied without an anchor history; it is not used.

no_request_time.de: Ohne Anforderungszeitpunkt ist eine Kürzung des Pakets nicht beurteilt.
no_request_time.en: Without a request time a truncation of the package is not judged.

archive_pages.de: Neben einer frischen Seite sind ältere Seiten verwendet.
archive_pages.en: Older pages are used beside a fresh page.

recent_roots_not_found.de: Wurzeln aus den 15 Minuten vor der Anforderung fehlen dem Paket; das Paket neu anfordern.
recent_roots_not_found.en: Roots from the 15 minutes before the request are missing from the package; request the package again.

package_ended_before_request.de: Das Paket endet vor einer Wurzel, die der Hersteller vor der Anforderung festgehalten hat: ein Export, der vor der Anforderung entstand, oder eine Kürzung an einem früheren Siegel.
package_ended_before_request.en: The package ends before a root the vendor recorded before the request: an export made before the request, or a truncation at an earlier seal.

reported_beyond_handover.de: Eine nur gemeldete Wurzel liegt hinter der Übergabe an die Nachfolgekette.
reported_beyond_handover.en: A root that was only reported lies beyond the handover to the successor chain.

package_beyond_handover.de: Das Paket reicht über die Übergabe an die Nachfolgekette hinaus.
package_beyond_handover.en: The package reaches beyond the handover to the successor chain.

predecessor_differs_from_genesis.de: Die Seite nennt eine andere Vorgängerkette als GENESIS.predecessor_chain.
predecessor_differs_from_genesis.en: The page names another predecessor chain than GENESIS.predecessor_chain.

linked_history_not_supplied.de: Die Seiten der Vorgängerkette sind nicht übergeben.
linked_history_not_supplied.en: The pages of the predecessor chain are not supplied.

receipt_roots_unverified_not_in_history.de: Quittungen, deren Schlüssel nicht über eine Anheftung oder die Liste des Pakets belegt ist, fehlen auf einer späteren Seite.
receipt_roots_unverified_not_in_history.en: Receipts whose key is not established by a pin or the package's list are missing from a later page.

completeness_blocking.page_rules: only on a page whose signature holds and whose statement_jcs reads as an I-JSON object with chain_id = C
contradiction: every H5 reason between two used pages of the package
completeness_blocking.not_blocking: H5 reasons between linked pages of another chain, page_rules on other pages, every reason of ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED and ANCHOR_HISTORY_DEFECTIVE, every note

no_usable_page.de: keine Seite für dieses Paket verwendbar
no_usable_page.en: no page usable for this package

owner_differs.de: die Seiten gehören zu einem anderen Gerät als dieses Paket
owner_differs.en: the pages belong to another device than this package

issued_before_request.de: keine Seite nach der Anforderung ausgestellt
issued_before_request.en: no page issued after the request

contradiction.de: die Anker-Historie widerspricht sich, den Quittungen oder dem Herstellerprotokoll
contradiction.en: the anchor history contradicts itself, the receipts or the vendor log

fork.de: die Anker-Historie zeigt eine zweite Fassung
fork.en: the anchor history shows a second version

root_missing.de: dem Paket fehlt eine Wurzel, die der Hersteller vor der Anforderung festgehalten hat
root_missing.en: the package lacks a root the vendor recorded before the request

no_root_found.de: keine Wurzel der Anker-Historie im Paket gefunden
no_root_found.en: no root of the anchor history found in the package

t <= N, root(t) != r, otherwise (e >= R - W_h, without R or only reported)
t > N, recorded (countersigned or gap_witness), R supplied, e < R - W_h
t > N, only reported, R supplied, e < R - W_h
t > N, R - W_h <= e < R

anchor_history.root_classification_comment: for every history root (t, r) that does not also carry the source auditor (format spec 8.8.5), the topmost case that applies; e is the earliest server_ts of its recordings countersigned and gap_witness, or, for a root that is only reported, of its recordings reported (H6); a root that is only reported never yields MERKLE_INCONSISTENT; a pair that carries the source auditor follows format spec 10.8; at most one finding per (t, r)

used_head.de: Anker-Historie: {used} von {distinct} Seiten verwendet ({fresh} nach der Anforderung ausgestellt, {stale} ältere Kopien), ausgestellt {first} bis {last}, Schlüssel {keys}; Gerät der Kette: passt zum Paket.
used_head.en: Anchor history: {used} of {distinct} pages used ({fresh} issued after the request, {stale} older copies), issued {first} to {last}, key {keys}; device of the chain: matches the package.

no_request_time.de: Ohne Anforderungszeitpunkt (--requested-at) ist eine Kürzung des Pakets nicht beurteilt; {unjudged} Wurzeln hinter dem Paketende sind gezählt, nicht bewertet.
no_request_time.en: Without a request time (--requested-at) a truncation of the package is not judged; {unjudged} roots beyond the package end are counted, not judged.

roots.de: Wurzeln: {distinct} verschieden; bis tree_size {entries}: {found} gefunden, {differing} weichen ab; dahinter: {before_request} vor der Anforderung festgehalten, {recent} in den 15 Minuten davor (Paket neu anfordern), {after_request} danach.
roots.en: Roots: {distinct} distinct; up to tree_size {entries}: {found} found, {differing} differ; beyond: {before_request} recorded before the request, {recent} in the 15 minutes before it (request the package again), {after_request} after it.

completeness_established.de: Vollständigkeit aus der Anker-Historie: belegt bis tree_size {up_to_tree_size}.
completeness_established.en: Completeness from the anchor history: evidenced up to tree_size {up_to_tree_size}.

completeness_not_established.de: Vollständigkeit aus der Anker-Historie: nicht belegt ({reason}).
completeness_not_established.en: Completeness from the anchor history: not evidenced ({reason}).

none_used.de: Anker-Historie: {distinct} Seiten übergeben, keine für dieses Paket verwendet ({reasons}).
none_used.en: Anchor history: {distinct} pages supplied, none used for this package ({reasons}).

not_supplied.de: Anker-Historie: nicht übergeben. Ob das Paket alles enthält, was der Hersteller vor der Anforderung festgehalten hat, ist damit nicht geprüft. Holen Sie die Historie mit der chain_id {chain_id} selbst beim Hersteller ab (GET /v1/anchors?chain_id={chain_id}&kind=ledger.anchor_history.v2) und übergeben Sie sie mit --anchor-history und --requested-at.
not_supplied.en: Anchor history: not supplied. Whether the package holds everything the vendor recorded before the request is therefore not checked. Fetch the history with the chain_id {chain_id} from the vendor yourself (GET /v1/anchors?chain_id={chain_id}&kind=ledger.anchor_history.v2) and pass it with --anchor-history and --requested-at.

source_role_list_builtin.de: Rollenliste Version {version}, im Verifier eingebaute Wurzel {wurzel_id}
source_role_list_builtin.en: role list version {version}, root {wurzel_id} built into this verifier

owner_differs_detail.de: Die Anker-Historie dieser chain_id gehört zu einem anderen Gerät als dieses Paket. Entweder hat eine andere Anlage diese chain_id zuerst beim Hersteller vorgelegt (möglich bei einer Kette, die nie verankert wurde), oder das Paket ist unter einem anderen Geräteschlüssel signiert als die Kette, die der Hersteller kennt. Ihre Wurzeln sind hier nicht verwendet.
owner_differs_detail.en: The anchor history of this chain_id belongs to another device than this package. Either another installation presented this chain_id to the vendor earlier (possible for a chain that was never anchored), or the package is signed under another device key than the chain the vendor knows. Its roots are not used here.

anchor_history.signature_pairs: identical statement_jcs are one page with the set of its distinct pairs (server_key_id, server_signature); H2 numbers 1, 2, 6 and 9 pass while one pair passes them and every earlier one of them; every failing pair under an established key gives ANCHOR_HISTORY_DEFECTIVE signature; the report uses the passing pair with the smallest server_key_id
anchor_history.classification_place: H8 is computed at format spec 10.5 step 8 and its findings are reported at step 13; H9 to H11 read the classification of step 8
anchor_history.page_reason_rule: H2 item 1: key_other_role if server_key_id names a key of K_cs or of the effective protocol key list, a countersigning or protocol pin, or an entry of the effective role list with a role other than statements; else key_not_established
anchor_history.v1_procedure: pages of kind v1 are never read (reason not_v2); the manual procedure of heartbeat spec 9.7 stays only for a vendor without a published role list: once the vendor has published a role list, an auditor after edition 1.10 never passes roots from pages of kind v1 as expected roots, and passes the root of a kept refusal only when a pair under a statements key carries it (heartbeat spec 9.5, 9.7)

affiliation.comment_de: Verbundenheit des Kunden mit dem Hersteller (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.10, Format-Spezifikation 8.8.6, ab Fassung 1.10): eine signierte Angabe des Herstellers in der Anker-Historie. Der Verifier prüft Signatur, Form, Bindung an Kette und Gerät, Frische und den Abgleich mit anderen übergebenen Seiten, nicht die Richtigkeit der Angabe (kein Beleg durch LEDGER). Sie ändert keinen Exit-Code, keinen Befund und nicht die Zahl der Beweisstufe.
affiliation.comment_en: Affiliation of the customer with the vendor (heartbeat spec 9.10, format spec 8.8.6, from edition 1.10): a signed statement of the vendor in the anchor history. The verifier checks signature, form, binding to chain and device, freshness and the comparison with other pages supplied, not the correctness of the statement (no evidence produced by LEDGER). It changes no exit code, no finding and not the number of the evidence level.

bases.order_comment: strictly ascending in this order (code point order) in every member bases

common_control.de: Hersteller und Kunde werden von derselben Seite beherrscht
common_control.en: vendor and customer are under common control

former_relation.de: eine der übrigen Beziehungen endete weniger als 24 Monate vor dem jeweiligen Zeitpunkt
former_relation.en: one of the other relations ended less than 24 months before the time in question

key_management.de: der Kunde ist eine Person in einer Schlüsselposition des Managements des Herstellers oder einer ihn beherrschenden Stelle, ein naher Familienangehöriger oder eine von ihnen beherrschte Stelle
key_management.en: the customer is a person in a key management position of the vendor or of a party controlling it, a close family member, or a party controlled by them

participation.de: Beteiligung von mindestens 20 Prozent ohne Beherrschung
participation.en: participation of at least 20 percent without control

shared_management.de: dieselbe Person in Geschäftsführung oder Aufsichtsorgan beider
shared_management.en: the same person in the management or supervisory body of both

vendor.de: der Kunde ist der Hersteller selbst
vendor.en: the customer is the vendor itself

bases.former_relation_end: 24 months after a time T is the same day at the same time of day (UTC) two calendar years later; if T falls on 29 February, it is 1 March two years later, 00:00:00.000Z (heartbeat spec 9.10)
bases.former_relation_comment: heartbeat spec 9.10: if a basis of relations 1 to 7 ends for a customer at T (in one of its register periods immediately before T and in none at T), the period T to 24 months after T (former_relation_end) with basis former_relation belongs to this customer; a register entry carries former_relation only for a relation that ended before it was entered (from = end, until = 24 months after the end) and yields no further period; the verifier reads the periods of a page and computes no end

affiliation.customer_definition: the licensee under whose licence the appliance the chain belongs to is registered at the time, and the operator declared for this licence
affiliation.not_determined_comment: with no used page of the package, the reason in this fixed order that a supplied page reached (format spec 8.8.6 item 2), history_no_package_page if none reached one; after item 7 the reason of the first condition that fails: statement_does_not_cover_package (freshness), known_range_too_short (known_since), history_pages_missing (coverage under H4 not complete)

history_owner_differs.de: die Anker-Historie gehört zu einem anderen Gerät als dieses Paket
history_owner_differs.en: the anchor history belongs to another device than this package

history_key_not_established.de: Schlüssel der Anker-Historie nicht durch einen Vertrauensanker des Prüfers belegt
history_key_not_established.en: key of the anchor history not established by a trust anchor of the auditor

history_key_not_valid.de: Schlüssel der Anker-Historie zum Ausstellzeitpunkt nicht gültig
history_key_not_valid.en: key of the anchor history not valid at the issue time

history_signing_time_not_proven.de: Seite mit widerrufenem Schlüssel und ohne Nachweis ihres Ausstellzeitpunkts
history_signing_time_not_proven.en: page under a revoked key without proof of its issue time

history_not_v2.de: übergebene Seiten haben nicht die Form ledger.anchor_history.v2
history_not_v2.en: pages supplied are not of kind ledger.anchor_history.v2

history_defective.en: signature of the anchor history does not hold

history_contradictory.en: anchor history violates its own format

known_range_too_short.de: der Hersteller kann den Kunden dieser Kette erst ab {known_since} benennen
known_range_too_short.en: the vendor can name the customer of this chain from {known_since} on

known_range_too_short_null.de: der Hersteller kann den Kunden dieser Kette derzeit für keinen Zeitraum benennen
known_range_too_short_null.en: the vendor currently cannot name the customer of this chain for any time

statement_does_not_cover_package.de: die Anker-Historie ist älter als die Anforderung des Pakets oder als seine jüngste Gegensignatur
statement_does_not_cover_package.en: the anchor history is older than the request of the package or than its latest countersignature

history_pages_missing.de: Seiten der Anker-Historie fehlen; ohne alle Seiten ist „nicht verbunden“ nicht belegt
history_pages_missing.en: pages of the anchor history are missing; without all pages "not affiliated" is not established

history_no_package_page.de: keine Seite der Anker-Historie dieser Kette übergeben
history_no_package_page.en: no page of the anchor history of this chain supplied

affiliated.de: Verbundenheit mit dem Hersteller: VERBUNDEN nach Angabe des Herstellers ({bases}; {periods}). {k} von {n} Gegensignaturen dieses Pakets fallen in diese Zeit. Für diese Zeit belegt eine Gegensignatur des Herstellers keine vom Kunden unabhängige Stelle. Ein Zeitzeuge bindet die Zeit an eine dritte Stelle nur, wenn die Zeitstempelstelle weder dem Kunden noch dem Hersteller zuzurechnen ist; das prüft der Verifier nicht. Die Angabe stammt aus der Anker-Historie vom {as_of} (Schlüssel {key_id}, {source}); der Verifier prüft Signatur, Form, Bindung an Kette und Gerät und den Abgleich mit anderen übergebenen Seiten, nicht ihre Richtigkeit.
affiliated.en: Affiliation with the vendor: AFFILIATED according to the vendor ({bases}; {periods}). {k} of {n} countersignatures of this package fall into this time. For this time a countersignature of the vendor evidences no party independent of the customer. A time witness binds the time to a third party only if the time-stamping authority is attributable neither to the customer nor to the vendor; the verifier does not check this. The statement comes from the anchor history of {as_of} (key {key_id}, {source}); the verifier checks signature, form, binding to chain and device and the comparison with other pages supplied, not its correctness.

affiliated_vendor_itself.de: Verbundenheit mit dem Hersteller: VERBUNDEN nach Angabe des Herstellers: Kunde ist der Hersteller selbst ({periods}). {k} von {n} Gegensignaturen dieses Pakets fallen in diese Zeit. Für diese Zeit belegt eine Gegensignatur des Herstellers keine vom Kunden unabhängige Stelle. Ein Zeitzeuge bindet die Zeit an eine dritte Stelle nur, wenn die Zeitstempelstelle weder dem Kunden noch dem Hersteller zuzurechnen ist; das prüft der Verifier nicht. Die Angabe stammt aus der Anker-Historie vom {as_of} (Schlüssel {key_id}, {source}); der Verifier prüft Signatur, Form, Bindung an Kette und Gerät und den Abgleich mit anderen übergebenen Seiten, nicht ihre Richtigkeit.
affiliated_vendor_itself.en: Affiliation with the vendor: AFFILIATED according to the vendor: the customer is the vendor itself ({periods}). {k} of {n} countersignatures of this package fall into this time. For this time a countersignature of the vendor evidences no party independent of the customer. A time witness binds the time to a third party only if the time-stamping authority is attributable neither to the customer nor to the vendor; the verifier does not check this. The statement comes from the anchor history of {as_of} (key {key_id}, {source}); the verifier checks signature, form, binding to chain and device and the comparison with other pages supplied, not its correctness.

not_affiliated.de: Verbundenheit mit dem Hersteller: keine im Zeitraum dieses Pakets ({from} bis {to}, Zeiten des Herstellers) nach Angabe des Herstellers in der Anker-Historie vom {as_of} (Schlüssel {key_id}, {source}). Der Verifier prüft Signatur und Form dieser Angabe, nicht ihre Richtigkeit.
not_affiliated.en: Affiliation with the vendor: none in the period of this package ({from} to {to}, vendor times) according to the vendor in the anchor history of {as_of} (key {key_id}, {source}). The verifier checks signature and form of this statement, not its correctness.

not_affiliated_outside.de: Außerhalb des Zeitraums dieses Pakets nennt der Hersteller eine Verbundenheit: {periods}.
not_affiliated_outside.en: Outside the period of this package the vendor states an affiliation: {periods}.

not_determined.de: Verbundenheit mit dem Hersteller: NICHT FESTGESTELLT ({reason}).
not_determined.en: Affiliation with the vendor: NOT DETERMINED ({reason}).

not_checked.de: Verbundenheit mit dem Hersteller: NICHT GEPRÜFT. Diese Angabe kommt aus der Anker-Historie des Herstellers, nicht aus dem Prüfpaket.
not_checked.en: Affiliation with the vendor: NOT CHECKED. This statement comes from the vendor's anchor history, not from the verification package.

not_checked_fetch.de: Holen Sie die Anker-Historie mit der chain_id {chain_id} selbst beim Hersteller ab und übergeben Sie sie mit --anchor-history.
not_checked_fetch.en: Fetch the anchor history with the chain_id {chain_id} from the vendor yourself and pass it with --anchor-history.

not_checked_never_anchored.de: Für eine Kette, von der der Hersteller nie einen Anker angenommen hat, führt er keine Anker-Historie; dann gibt es aus dieser Quelle keine Angabe, auch nicht für einen verbundenen Kunden (Abschnitt 11.2).
not_checked_never_anchored.en: For a chain from which the vendor never accepted an anchor it keeps no anchor history; then this source gives no statement, not even for an affiliated customer (section 11.2).

open_at_level_2.de: Ob der Gegenzeichner mit dem Kunden verbunden ist, ist damit offen; Stufe 2 sagt darüber nichts.
open_at_level_2.en: Whether the countersigner is affiliated with the customer is therefore open; level 2 says nothing about it.

affiliation.texts_comment: the line on affiliation is the last line of the evidence level block, for every report with an exit code other than 3, also in the state chain_invalid; not_checked is followed by not_checked_fetch if the package carries a receipt whose signature holds, else by not_checked_never_anchored; with not_checked and not_determined at level 2 or higher open_at_level_2 follows; with not_determined and the reason known_range_too_short the reason text is reason_texts.known_range_too_short, or reason_texts.known_range_too_short_null when known_since of H* is null (format spec 10.10.3); {source} as verifier.anchor_history.texts.source_*; no text calls a time witness independent
affiliation.periods_rule: the end of a period is its until; a period with until null ends at the server_ts of its page, except on H*, where it has no end; a period covers from <= t < end; it overlaps the package if from <= span_to and it has no end or its end lies after span_from
affiliation.not_affiliated_rule: not_affiliated needs (a) R and H* fresh, or no R and as_of not before any established receipt, (b) known_since not null and not after span_from, (c) coverage under H4 complete

evidence_level.comment_de: Beweisstufe (Format-Spezifikation 10.9, ab Fassung 1.10): Angabe des Berichts, kein Befund, ändert den Exit-Code nicht und gilt für jedes Paket, gleich welche spec_version es erklärt. Die Beweisstufe unterstützt Aussagen darüber, wie stark die vorliegende Kette gegen ein Umschreiben durch ihren Schlüsselinhaber belegt ist; sie gewährleistet nichts, ist keine rechtliche Einordnung und sagt nichts über den Inhalt der Aufrufe. Reihenfolgen tragen allein die Listen, nie die Reihenfolge von Objektschlüsseln. Platzhalter {…} ersetzt der Verifier.
evidence_level.comment_en: Evidence level (format spec 10.9, from edition 1.10): report member, no finding, does not change the exit code and applies to every package whatever spec_version it declares. The evidence level supports statements on how strongly the chain presented is evidenced against rewriting by its key holder; it guarantees nothing, is no legal classification and says nothing about the content of the calls. Order is carried by the lists alone, never by the order of object keys. The verifier replaces the placeholders {…}.
evidence_level.material_classes_comment: an exit-2 finding of another class gives the state chain_invalid; exit 2 only from these classes gives the state rated with the note material_contradiction; a class that a later edition moves to exit 2 MUST join a list that acts like this one

rated.comment: also exit 2 when every exit-2 finding is of a class in material_classes

0.de: Die Kette ist in sich geprüft. Ein Beleg durch eine vom Schlüsselinhaber unabhängige Stelle, den der Prüfer bestätigt hat, liegt nicht vor.
0.en: The chain is checked in itself. There is no evidence from a party independent of the key holder that the auditor has confirmed.

1.de: Mindestens ein Stand der Kette ist an einen Zeitzeugen gebunden, dessen Stelle eine Wurzel des Prüfers bestätigt, oder an eine erwartete Wurzel, die der Prüfer übergibt oder die aus einer geprüften Anker-Historie stammt.
1.en: At least one state of the chain is bound to a time witness whose authority a root of the auditor confirms, or to an expected root that the auditor supplies or that comes from a checked anchor history.

2.de: Mindestens eine Gegensignatur trägt unter einem Schlüssel, den ein Anker des Prüfers bestätigt. Über die Vollständigkeit sagt diese Stufe nichts.
2.en: At least one countersignature holds under a key an anchor of the auditor confirms. This level says nothing about completeness.

3.de: Zusätzlich liegen vor: ein Zeitstempel einer Stelle, die der Prüfer als qualifiziert benannt hat und deren Token sich als qualifiziert ausweist, als Zeitzeuge auf der Kette oder auf dem Tageseintrag des Herstellerprotokolls, in dem die Gegensignatur nachgewiesen ist; der Nachweis der Gegensignaturen in bezeugten Tagen des Herstellerprotokolls; die Vollständigkeit nach einer geprüften Anker-Historie, die nach der Anforderung des Pakets ausgestellt wurde. Einträge nach der jüngsten verankerten Wurzel bleiben im Restfenster (Abschnitt 11.2).
3.en: In addition there are: a time stamp of an authority the auditor named as qualified whose token declares itself qualified, as a time witness on the chain or on the day entry of the vendor log in which the countersignature is shown; the proof of the countersignatures in witnessed days of the vendor log; completeness according to a checked anchor history issued after the request of the package. Entries after the latest anchored root remain in the residual window (section 11.2).

3.comment: an element of conditions is a code or a group of the same form {need, conditions}; the group of time_witness_qualified and log_day_qualified is met when one of them is met and reaches as far as the larger reach of those met, the two ways to the qualified time (format spec 10.9.1, 10.9.5)

reach.r3: min(reach(receipt_key_confirmed), max(reach(time_witness_qualified), reach(log_day_qualified)), reach(receipts_logged), reach(completeness_from_history)) if receipt_key_confirmed, receipts_logged, completeness_from_history and at least one of time_witness_qualified and log_day_qualified are met, else 0; if both are met, the larger reach counts
reach.reach_of_condition: up_to_tree_size of the condition if it is met, else 0
reach.lvl: lvl(p) = max{k in 0..3 : r_k >= p} for every position seq p with 1 <= p <= N
reach.up_to_tree_size: r_level, at level 0 equal to N
reach.segments: maximal runs of consecutive positions with equal lvl(p), ascending by seq, each with level, first_seq, last_seq and basis; their levels fall strictly and they cover seq 1 to N without gap
reach.basis: at level 3 the met codes among receipt_key_confirmed, time_witness_qualified, receipts_logged, completeness_from_history, log_day_qualified whose reach equals r3; at level 2 receipt_key_confirmed; at level 1 the met codes among time_witness, expected_root_found, receipt_key_confirmed whose reach equals r1; at level 0 none; in condition_order
reach.next: in the state rated and at a level L below 3: {level: L + 1, need: any at L = 0 else all, missing: the conditions of level L + 1 that are not met, in condition_order}; for level 3 time_witness_qualified and log_day_qualified count as one condition: if neither is met, missing names both and the report says that one of them suffices, if one is met, missing names neither; null at level 3 and outside the state rated

time_witness.de: Zeitzeuge, dessen Stelle eine vom Prüfer übergebene Wurzel bestätigt (7.3)
time_witness.en: time witness whose authority a root supplied by the auditor confirms (7.3)
time_witness.items: every TIME_ANCHOR, per root of purpose chain
time_witness.reach: largest tree_size of a credited TIME_ANCHOR

expected_root_found.de: erwartete Wurzel des Prüfers oder aus der Anker-Historie im Paket gefunden (10.8)
expected_root_found.en: expected root of the auditor or from the anchor history found in the package (10.8)
expected_root_found.items: every found expected root of source auditor or anchor_history; roots of the vendor log are no expected roots and never count

receipt_key_confirmed.de: Gegensignatur, deren Schlüssel ein Anker des Prüfers bestätigt (7.1)
receipt_key_confirmed.en: countersignature whose key an anchor of the auditor confirms (7.1)
receipt_key_confirmed.items: every CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT whose signature holds after format spec 7.1
receipt_key_confirmed.reach: largest tree_size of a credited receipt
receipt_key_confirmed.comment: a receipt under a protocol key and a receipt whose key only an auditor list names have the origin manifest (format spec 7.1)

time_witness_qualified.de: Zeitzeuge einer vom Prüfer als qualifiziert benannten Stelle, dessen Token sich als qualifiziert ausweist
time_witness_qualified.en: time witness of an authority the auditor named as qualified, whose token declares itself qualified
time_witness_qualified.items: every TIME_ANCHOR, per root of purpose qualified
time_witness_qualified.stage_codes_comment: QS malformed gives qualified_statement_malformed, absent gives no_qualified_statement; where pairs fail at this stage with both results, qualified_statement_malformed wins
time_witness_qualified.reach: largest tree_size of a credited TIME_ANCHOR
time_witness_qualified.stages_comment: signature_not_checkable: step 5 not performable under 5a, or Z.6 cannot be checked (7.5.6)

receipts_logged.de: Gegensignaturen in bezeugten Tagen des Herstellerprotokolls nachgewiesen (7.4)
receipts_logged.en: countersignatures shown in witnessed days of the vendor log (7.4)
receipts_logged.items: the receipts of format spec 7.4.10 step L8 (signature holds under 7.1, no RECEIPT_INVALID), in chain order, each with its class of step L8

global_from.vendor_log_contradiction: a finding VENDOR_LOG_CONTRADICTION without day or on a day of the required range [Lo, T] of this package (format spec 7.4.10 L7)

receipts_logged.pre_reach: r5' = the largest tree_size t of a good receipt such that every receipt with tree_size <= t is good or neutral; 0 if there is none; receipts are those of format spec 7.4.10 step L8 (signature holds under 7.1, no RECEIPT_INVALID)

cap.t_m: the smallest tree_size of a finding LOGGED_ROOT_MISMATCH
cap.reach: min(r5', t_m - 1) if such a finding exists, else r5'

receipts_logged.met: no global reason applies and the reach is at least 1
reason_order: receipts_before_log_start if every receipt is neutral
the code of the foremost bad receipt in chain order if r5' = 0
logged_root_mismatch if r5' >= 1 and the cap sets the reach to 0
receipts_logged.count: good receipts up to the reach
receipts_logged.own_witnessing_time_stamp: a day counts only by its own witnessing time stamp (format spec 7.4.6)

completeness_from_history.de: Vollständigkeit nach einer geprüften Anker-Historie, ausgestellt nach der Anforderung des Pakets (8.8)
completeness_from_history.en: completeness according to a checked anchor history issued after the request of the package (8.8)
completeness_from_history.from_completeness_comment: root_missing does not occur in the state rated: a MERKLE_INCONSISTENT from a history root gives chain_invalid; expected roots of the source auditor never satisfy this condition

log_day_qualified.de: Gegensignaturen in Tagen des Herstellerprotokolls nachgewiesen, deren Eintrag den Zeitstempel einer vom Prüfer als qualifiziert benannten Stelle trägt, der sich als qualifiziert ausweist, höchstens 36 Stunden nach der Gegensignatur (7.4.6)
log_day_qualified.en: countersignatures shown in days of the vendor log whose entry carries a time stamp of an authority the auditor named as qualified, which declares itself qualified, at most 36 hours after the countersignature (7.4.6)
log_day_qualified.items: every receipt of class included (format spec 7.4.10, step L8), per time stamp s of the canonical entry c(d) of its day d = day(server_ts) that is not defective (format spec 7.5.7), per root of the root table that carries both purposes log and qualified

global_from.no_qualified_log_root_supplied: no entry of the root table carries both purposes log and qualified
global_from.no_receipt_included: no receipt has the class included

log_day_qualified.late: genTime truncated to whole milliseconds >= end(d) + vendor_log.time.token_window_ms
log_day_qualified.gap: genTime truncated to whole milliseconds minus server_ts of the receipt is greater than gap_max_ms (G_q)
log_day_qualified.gap_comment: G_q = 129 600 000 ms (36 hours, format spec 10.9.1, 10.9.4): an honest vendor closes a day shortly after its end, at the latest by its due time at 06:00 UTC of the next day (heartbeat spec 9.9); a countersignature shortly after midnight then lies up to 30 hours before the stamp, and six hours remain for an outage of the authority; a receipt counts for log_day_qualified only if at most G_q lies between its server_ts and the genTime of the time stamp
log_day_qualified.no_package_root_stage: no stage qualified_root_in_package: the tokens come from the vendor log, not from the package
log_day_qualified.lower_bound_comment: a confirmed premature time stamp breaks its day (format spec 7.4.10, L2 (h)); a receipt of such a day is never included, so no triple has a premature time stamp
log_day_qualified.defective_comment: a defective time stamp forms no triple; a time stamp that violates Z.6 is defective for day entries (format spec 7.5.7)
log_day_qualified.own_witnessing_time_stamp: only time stamps of c(d) itself count, never a later day through prev_hash (format spec 7.4.6)
log_day_qualified.receipt_key: a receipt counts for log_day_qualified whatever establishes its key, as for receipts_logged
log_day_qualified.reach: largest tree_size of a credited receipt

evidence_level.evaluation: first the global reasons in table order: if one applies the condition is not met and the foremost applying one is its reason; else every item is checked against the stages (for time_witness and time_witness_qualified every pair of item and root, for log_day_qualified every triple of receipt, time stamp and root); s = the number of stages a pair or triple passes in table order without interruption; an item is credited if it passes every stage for one and the same root (for log_day_qualified: the same time stamp and root); stages of different roots are never combined; with no item credited the reason is the code of the stage with index max(s) over all pairs

no_time_anchor.en: no time witness in the chain

no_tsa_root_supplied.de: keine Wurzel für Zeitzeugen der Kette übergeben (--tsa-root, --tsa-qualified-roots)
no_tsa_root_supplied.en: no root for time witnesses of the chain supplied (--tsa-root, --tsa-qualified-roots)

signature_not_checkable.de: die Signatur oder, bei (4), die Bindung des Signiererzertifikats keines dieser Zeitstempel ist nach dem Zeitstempelprofil prüfbar (7.5, Z.6)
signature_not_checkable.en: neither the signature nor, for (4), the binding of the signer certificate of any of these time stamps can be checked under the time-stamp profile (7.5, Z.6)

not_chained_to_auditor_root.de: kein Zeitzeuge kettet zu seinem genTime zu einer übergebenen Wurzel
not_chained_to_auditor_root.en: no time witness chains, at its genTime, to a root supplied

published_test_key.de: die Stelle nutzt einen Schlüssel, dessen privater Teil veröffentlicht ist (kein Zeuge)
published_test_key.en: the authority uses a key whose private part is published (no witness)

token_extensions_unusable.de: der Token trägt eine unbekannte kritische oder nicht lesbare TSTInfo-Erweiterung
token_extensions_unusable.en: the token carries an unknown critical or unreadable TSTInfo extension

no_expected_root_found.de: keine erwartete Wurzel im Paket gefunden (keine übergeben, oder die Anker-Historie nennt nur Wurzeln hinter dem Paketende)
no_expected_root_found.en: no expected root found in the package (none supplied, or the anchor history names only roots beyond the package end)

key_not_confirmed.de: Gegensignaturen stimmig, ihr Schlüssel aber durch keinen Anker des Prüfers bestätigt (--vendor-root, --vendor-key)
key_not_confirmed.en: countersignatures consistent, but no anchor of the auditor confirms their key (--vendor-root, --vendor-key)

key_is_device_key.de: der als Herstellerschlüssel bestätigte Schlüssel ist ein Geräteschlüssel dieser Kette
key_is_device_key.en: the key confirmed as the vendor's is a device key of this chain

no_qualified_root_supplied.de: keine als qualifiziert benannte Wurzel übergeben (--tsa-qualified-roots)
no_qualified_root_supplied.en: no root named as qualified supplied (--tsa-qualified-roots)

not_chained_to_qualified_root.de: kein Zeitzeuge kettet zu seinem genTime zu einer als qualifiziert benannten Wurzel
not_chained_to_qualified_root.en: no time witness chains, at its genTime, to a root named as qualified

qualified_root_in_package.de: die als qualifiziert benannte Wurzel hat denselben Schlüssel wie ein Zertifikat aus keys/tsa/ des Pakets und zählt dafür nicht
qualified_root_in_package.en: the root named as qualified has the same key as a certificate in the package's keys/tsa/ and does not count for this

outside_qualified_window.de: genTime liegt außerhalb des Zeitraums, für den der Prüfer die Wurzel als qualifiziert benannt hat
outside_qualified_window.en: genTime lies outside the period for which the auditor named the root as qualified

signing_certificate_not_bound.de: die signierten Attribute des Tokens nennen das Signiererzertifikat nicht, eines von signingCertificate und signingCertificateV2 nennt ein anderes, oder eines davon ist nicht nach Z.6 gebildet (RFC 3161 2.4.1, RFC 5816)
signing_certificate_not_bound.en: the token's signed attributes do not name the signer certificate, one of signingCertificate and signingCertificateV2 names another one, or one of them is not formed per Z.6 (RFC 3161 2.4.1, RFC 5816)

qualified_statement_malformed.de: die qcStatements-Erweiterung des Tokens ist nicht lesbar
qualified_statement_malformed.en: the token's qcStatements extension is unreadable

no_qualified_statement.de: der Token weist sich nicht als qualifizierter Zeitstempel aus (qcStatements mit esi4-qtstStatement-1, ETSI EN 319 422)
no_qualified_statement.en: the token does not declare itself a qualified time stamp (qcStatements with esi4-qtstStatement-1, ETSI EN 319 422)

vendor_log_not_established.de: Auszug übergeben, aber kein Protokollschlüssel durch einen Anker des Prüfers belegt
