vendor_log_not_established.en: extract supplied, but no protocol key established by an anchor of the auditor

receipt_not_logged.de: eine Gegensignatur fehlt im bezeugten Tag ihres Herstellerprotokolls (RECEIPT_NOT_LOGGED)
receipt_not_logged.en: a countersignature is missing from the witnessed day of its vendor log (RECEIPT_NOT_LOGGED)

day_timestamp_not_confirmed.de: der Tageseintrag zum Tag einer Gegensignatur ist durch keinen Zeitstempel bezeugt, den eine Wurzel des Prüfers für das Protokoll bestätigt (--vendor-log-tsa-root)
day_timestamp_not_confirmed.en: the day entry for the day of a countersignature is witnessed by no time stamp that a root of the auditor for the log confirms (--vendor-log-tsa-root)

receipt_not_checkable.de: für den Tag einer Gegensignatur fehlt ein tragender Kettentag-Nachweis, oder Nachweise oder Tageseinträge widersprechen sich
receipt_not_checkable.en: for the day of a countersignature a chain-day record that holds is missing, or records or day entries contradict each other

receipt_day_not_closed.de: der Tag einer Gegensignatur ist noch nicht fällig; ab 06:00 UTC des Folgetags erneut prüfen
receipt_day_not_closed.en: the day of a countersignature is not due yet; check again from 06:00 UTC of the following day

receipt_after_check_time.de: eine Gegensignatur trägt einen server_ts nach dem Prüfzeitpunkt; kein abgeschlossener Tag kann sie enthalten
receipt_after_check_time.en: a countersignature carries a server_ts after the check time; no closed day can contain it

log_day_not_supplied.de: für den Tag einer Gegensignatur liegt kein Tageseintrag vor; einen vollständigen, aktuellen Auszug abrufen
log_day_not_supplied.en: there is no day entry for the day of a countersignature; fetch a complete, current extract

receipts_before_log_start.de: alle Gegensignaturen liegen vor dem Beginn des Herstellerprotokolls
receipts_before_log_start.en: all countersignatures lie before the start of the vendor log

logged_root_mismatch.de: eine im Herstellerprotokoll festgehaltene Wurzel widerspricht dem Paket (LOGGED_ROOT_MISMATCH); Stufe 3 endet davor
logged_root_mismatch.en: a root recorded in the vendor log contradicts the package (LOGGED_ROOT_MISMATCH); level 3 ends before it

requested_at_not_supplied.de: ohne Anforderungszeitpunkt (--requested-at) ist die Vollständigkeit nicht beurteilt
requested_at_not_supplied.en: without a request time (--requested-at) completeness is not judged

anchor_history_not_established.de: Anker-Historie übergeben, für dieses Paket aber nicht belegt (ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED)
anchor_history_not_established.en: anchor history supplied, but not established for this package (ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED)

anchor_history_partial.en: pages of the anchor history are missing (ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED)

anchor_history_contradiction.de: die Anker-Historie widerspricht sich, den Quittungen oder dem Herstellerprotokoll oder zeigt eine zweite Fassung (ANCHOR_HISTORY_CONTRADICTION, ANCHOR_HISTORY_FORK)
anchor_history_contradiction.en: the anchor history contradicts itself, the receipts or the vendor log, or shows a second version (ANCHOR_HISTORY_CONTRADICTION, ANCHOR_HISTORY_FORK)

no_history_root_found.de: keine Wurzel der Anker-Historie im Paket gefunden
no_history_root_found.en: no root of the anchor history found in the package

no_qualified_log_root_supplied.de: keine Wurzel übergeben, die zugleich für Zeitstempel des Herstellerprotokolls übergeben und als qualifiziert benannt ist (--vendor-log-tsa-root und --tsa-qualified-roots)
no_qualified_log_root_supplied.en: no root supplied both for time stamps of the vendor log and as named qualified (--vendor-log-tsa-root and --tsa-qualified-roots)

no_receipt_included.de: keine Gegensignatur im bezeugten Tag ihres Herstellerprotokolls nachgewiesen
no_receipt_included.en: no countersignature shown in the witnessed day of its vendor log

not_chained_to_qualified_log_root.de: kein Zeitstempel eines Tages mit nachgewiesener Gegensignatur kettet zu seinem genTime zu einer Wurzel, die für das Protokoll übergeben und als qualifiziert benannt ist
not_chained_to_qualified_log_root.en: no time stamp of a day with a countersignature shown chains, at its genTime, to a root supplied for the log and named as qualified

qualified_day_stamp_late.de: der Zeitstempel der als qualifiziert benannten Stelle liegt nach dem Zeitfenster von 48 Stunden nach Tagesende (7.4.6)
qualified_day_stamp_late.en: the time stamp of the authority named as qualified lies after the window of 48 hours after the end of the day (7.4.6)

qualified_day_stamp_gap.de: der Zeitstempel der als qualifiziert benannten Stelle liegt mehr als 36 Stunden nach der Gegensignatur (10.9.4)
qualified_day_stamp_gap.en: the time stamp of the authority named as qualified lies more than 36 hours after the countersignature (10.9.4)

material_contradiction.de: Vorgelegte Klartexte oder Berichte widersprechen der Kette (CONTENT_MISMATCH, REPORT_MISMATCH); die Stufe gilt für die Kette, nicht für dieses Material.
material_contradiction.en: Presented plaintexts or reports contradict the chain (CONTENT_MISMATCH, REPORT_MISMATCH); the level applies to the chain, not to this material.

unsealed_end.de: Kettenende nicht versiegelt; die Stufe gilt für die vorliegenden Einträge.
unsealed_end.en: Chain end not sealed; the level applies to the entries present.

stale_package.de: Die Kette endet vor dem Freshness-Fenster (TRAILING_SILENCE); über die Zeit danach sagt die Stufe nichts.
stale_package.en: The chain ends before the freshness window (TRAILING_SILENCE); the level says nothing about the time after it.

package_not_fully_known.de: Das Paket trägt Angaben, die diese Verifier-Fassung nicht kennt; die Stufe beruht nur auf dem, was sie liest.
package_not_fully_known.en: The package carries data this verifier version does not know; the level rests only on what it reads.

vendor_root_builtin_only.de: Der Herstellerschlüssel ist nur über die in diesen Verifier eingebaute Herstellerwurzel bestätigt; die Stufe ist nur so unabhängig wie dieser Build.
vendor_root_builtin_only.en: The vendor key is confirmed only through the vendor root built into this verifier; the level is only as independent as this build.

published_test_key_credited.de: Die Stufe beruht auf einem veröffentlichten Testschlüssel (published_test_keys); mit ihm kann jeder signieren. Gegen eine Fälschung belegt die Stufe damit nichts.
published_test_key_credited.en: The level rests on a published test key (published_test_keys); anyone can sign with it. The level thus proves nothing against a forgery.

last_receipt_not_confirmed.de: Die Gegensignatur des letzten gegengezeichneten Checkpoints ist über keinen Anker des Prüfers bestätigt; Stufe 2 reicht bis tree_size {t}.
last_receipt_not_confirmed.en: The countersignature of the last countersigned checkpoint is confirmed through no anchor of the auditor; level 2 reaches tree_size {t}.

expected_root_auditor_only.de: Stufe 1 beruht nur auf erwarteten Wurzeln, die der Prüfer übergeben hat; sie trägt so weit, wie er sie vor der Prüfung und außerhalb des geprüften Hauses erhalten hat.
expected_root_auditor_only.en: Level 1 rests only on expected roots the auditor supplied; it holds as far as the auditor received them before the audit and from outside the audited organisation.

tsa_root_in_package.de: Eine Wurzel für Zeitstempelstellen, auf der die Stufe beruht, hat denselben Schlüssel wie ein Zertifikat aus keys/tsa/ des Pakets. Das ist kein Mangel des Pakets; der Prüfer sollte sie außerhalb des Pakets beschafft haben.
tsa_root_in_package.en: A root for time-stamping authorities on which the level rests has the same key as a certificate in the package's keys/tsa/. This is no defect of the package; the auditor should have obtained it outside the package.

history_recent_roots_skipped.de: Wurzeln aus den 15 Minuten vor der Anforderung liegen hinter dem Paketende; das Paket neu anfordern (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.7).
history_recent_roots_skipped.en: Roots from the 15 minutes before the request lie beyond the package end; request the package again (heartbeat specification 9.7).

receipts_pending_log.de: Gegensignaturen von Tagen, deren Eintrag noch nicht fällig ist; ab 06:00 UTC des Folgetags erneut prüfen.
receipts_pending_log.en: Countersignatures of days whose entry is not due yet; check again from 06:00 UTC of the following day.

receipt_not_logged.de: Mindestens eine Gegensignatur ist im Herstellerprotokoll nicht nachgewiesen (RECEIPT_NOT_LOGGED); Stufe 3 endet davor, Stufe 2 bleibt.
receipt_not_logged.en: At least one countersignature is not shown in the vendor log (RECEIPT_NOT_LOGGED); level 3 ends before it, level 2 remains.

log_day_not_supplied.de: Für Tage mit Gegensignaturen, deren Eintrag schon vorliegen müsste, wurde kein Tageseintrag übergeben; einen vollständigen, aktuellen Auszug abrufen.
log_day_not_supplied.en: For days with countersignatures whose entry should already exist no day entry was supplied; fetch a complete, current extract.

logged_root_mismatch.de: Eine im Herstellerprotokoll festgehaltene Wurzel widerspricht dem Paket (LOGGED_ROOT_MISMATCH); Stufe 3 endet davor, Stufe 2 bleibt.
logged_root_mismatch.en: A root recorded in the vendor log contradicts the package (LOGGED_ROOT_MISMATCH); level 3 ends before it, level 2 remains.

cms_not_implemented.de: Dieser Verifier prüft Signatur und Signaturkette von Zeitstempeln nicht (7.3); über Zeitzeugen erreicht er keine Stufe, Stufe 3 nicht.
cms_not_implemented.en: This verifier does not check signature and signature chain of time stamps (7.3); through time witnesses it reaches no level, and not level 3.

note_occasions.material_contradiction: exit-2 findings exist, all from material_classes
note_occasions.vendor_root_builtin_only: receipt_key_confirmed is met and the key of every credited receipt is established only through a list the built-in vendor root carries
note_occasions.published_test_key_credited: a condition that is met rests on a key whose public key is listed as an Ed25519 test key in published_test_keys: for receipt_key_confirmed the key of a credited receipt or the vendor root of its list; for receipts_logged an established protocol key or the root of the effective protocol key list; for expected_root_found with the source anchor_history and for completeness_from_history the key of a used page of the package on which one of them rests (completeness_from_history rests on the fresh used pages of the package, format spec 10.10.2), or the vendor root of the role list that establishes this key (format spec 8.8.3); a pinned statements key rests on no role list
note_occasions.last_receipt_not_confirmed: receipt_key_confirmed is met and the receipt that format spec 8.6 chooses as the last countersigned one is not credited; {t} is the reach of receipt_key_confirmed
note_occasions.expected_root_auditor_only: level 1 at seq 1 rests only on expected_root_found and every root credited for it carries only the source auditor; rests only on expected_root_found means: the level at seq 1 is 1 and, of the conditions of level 1, only expected_root_found is met; the basis of the first segment is not the criterion
note_occasions.tsa_root_in_package: a root credited by time_witness has the SPKI SHA-256 value of a certificate from keys/tsa/
note_occasions.history_recent_roots_skipped: the anchor history gives the note recent_roots_not_found
note_occasions.receipts_pending_log: a receipt has the class pending
note_occasions.log_day_not_supplied: a receipt has the class missing
note_occasions.cms_not_implemented: the verifier does not perform steps 5 and 6 of format spec 7.3 (never for the reference verifiers)

evidence_level.notes_rule: notes never change the level; each one stands in the report exactly when its occasion applies, once, in note_order, only in the state rated
evidence_level.anchors_count: only anchors the auditor brings and the vendor root built into the verifier, which the report names; never the system root store, certificates and keys from the package (keys/tsa/, keys/vendor/, manifest.vendor_pubkeys), certificates from a token as trust anchors, a key of a signer or root whose private part is published (verifier.timestamp_profile.published_test_keys), a vendor key equal to a device key of the chain, a pin dropped after format spec 10.7.4, a key of a role other than that of the object it is to establish (format spec 10.7.3), and for time_witness_qualified a root with the key of a certificate from keys/tsa/; keys of certificates are compared by their SPKI SHA-256 value
evidence_level.affiliation_rule: the affiliation (verifier.affiliation) is shown beside the level; it enters no condition and changes neither the number of the level nor its reach nor the segments; no note depends on it
properties: with NO_ANCHOR in the state rated the level is 0; from level 1 on there is no NO_ANCHOR
from level 2 on at least one receipt holds under a key an anchor of the auditor confirms
the segments cover seq 1 to N without gap with strictly falling levels; the foremost has the level level
state is format_error exactly when the exit code is 3
without the level step every run gives the same exit code and the same findings
both reference verifiers output identical evidence_level objects for the same inputs
evidence_level.monotonicity: for a package P and auditor inputs I subset of I' : r_k(P, I') >= r_k(P, I) for every k, unless the run with I' has, and the run with I has not: the state chain_invalid; a finding RECEIPT_NOT_LOGGED, LOGGED_ROOT_MISMATCH, VENDOR_LOG_CONTRADICTION, ANCHOR_HISTORY_CONTRADICTION or ANCHOR_HISTORY_FORK; a finding VENDOR_LOG_UNVERIFIED with reason key_in_two_roles or lists_contradictory; a finding ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED with reason key_not_valid or signing_time_not_proven; the status not_effective of key_roles with reason lists_contradictory or key_in_two_roles, or an entry in key_roles.pins_dropped; a finding ANCHOR_HISTORY_UNVERIFIED with reason key_not_established or key_other_role where an added input made the role list not effective or dropped a statements pin; or a finding RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED where an added role list dropped a countersigning pin; these exceptions arise when an added input states revocation, validity or role of a key (a newer key list with widerrufen_ab, a pin equal to a protocol key, a role list that gives a pinned key another role, a second list of the same version with other content); a changed input (another request time, another check time) is not covered
evidence_level.neutrality: the same package with the affiliation affiliated, not_affiliated, not_determined and not_checked gives the same level, up_to_tree_size and segments
evidence_level.kat_comment: reference values of format spec 10.9.5: reaches of the conditions that are met; segments as [level, first_seq, last_seq, basis]; next where the table names it; for level 3 time_witness_qualified and log_day_qualified count as one condition, so in KAT10 next names both and one of them suffices

head.de: {label} {level} von 3 ({name}), belegt für seq 1 bis {up_to_tree_size} von {entries}.
head.en: {label} {level} of 3 ({name}), evidenced for seq 1 to {up_to_tree_size} of {entries}.

qualified_time_witness.de: qualifiziert bestätigt: spätestens {latest} (Zeitzeuge der Kette, tree_size {tree_size})
qualified_time_witness.en: qualified confirmation: at the latest {latest} (time witness of the chain, tree_size {tree_size})

qualified_time_log.de: qualifiziert bestätigt: spätestens {latest} (Zeitstempel des Herstellerprotokolls, tree_size {tree_size}, {gap} nach der Gegensignatur)
qualified_time_log.en: qualified confirmation: at the latest {latest} (time stamp of the vendor log, tree_size {tree_size}, {gap} after the countersignature)

next_any.de: für Stufe {n} fehlt eine dieser Bedingungen:
next_any.en: for level {n} one of these conditions is missing:

direct_to_2.de: Eine bestätigte Gegensignatur führt unmittelbar zu Stufe 2.
direct_to_2.en: A confirmed countersignature leads directly to level 2.

disclaimer.de: Die Beweisstufe unterstützt Aussagen darüber, wie stark die vorliegende Kette gegen ein Umschreiben durch ihren Schlüsselinhaber belegt ist. Sie gewährleistet nichts und sagt nichts über den Inhalt der Aufrufe. Sie ist nur so unabhängig wie dieser Verifier und die Angaben, die der Prüfer ihm übergeben hat.
disclaimer.en: The evidence level supports statements on how strongly the chain presented is evidenced against rewriting by its key holder. It guarantees nothing and says nothing about the content of the calls. It is only as independent as this verifier and the inputs the auditor gave it.

anchor_statement_role_list.en: statements key {key_id} from role list version {version}, {root}

anchor_qualified_file.de: Datei der qualifizierten Wurzeln, Stand {stand}, Quelle {quelle}
anchor_qualified_file.en: file of qualified roots, as of {stand}, source {quelle}

browser.de: Beweisstufe: {level} von 3, belegt bis seq {up_to_tree_size} von {entries}
browser.en: Evidence level: {level} of 3, evidenced up to seq {up_to_tree_size} of {entries}

evidence_level.text_rules: of a condition the texts say liegt vor (present) or fehlt (missing); no level name contains unabhängig; qualifiziert only as vom Prüfer als qualifiziert benannt or weist sich als qualifiziert aus, never as a statement on the status of an authority; no text says the chain, the operator or LEDGER complies with a rule (language rule of spec/pflichten.de.md section 4); no text names a particular vendor

example.comment: the object of format spec 10.10.2 for valid_basic in the corpus environment, in JCS order, with every member of 10.10.2 (qualified_time null below level 3, 10.10.1) and next.missing after 10.9.5 (time_witness_qualified and log_day_qualified both, neither being met); the one-line example in the text of 10.10.2 (spec/format.de.md and spec/format.en.md) is the JCS form of this object

reason_conditions.comment: codes used by more than one condition (format spec 10.9.4, column Bedingung); every other code belongs to the condition that lists it

monotonicity_breakers_conditional.when: an added input made the role list not effective or dropped a statements pin
an added role list dropped a countersigning pin

evidence_level.texts_rule: every line of the block after the first is indented by two spaces, the lines of the missing conditions by four; at level 0 without receipt_key_confirmed the line direct_to_2 follows after the missing conditions, indented by two spaces; in the states chain_invalid and format_error the lines after state_line (disclaimer, and for chain_invalid the line on affiliation) are indented by two spaces; several anchors in {anchors} and several sources in anchor_expected_sources are joined with ", " (comma and space); {anchors} names for receipt_key_confirmed the keys of the credited receipts as anchors.vendor_keys and for the other conditions the anchors those conditions name, for completeness_from_history as_of of the anchor history and the statements keys of the pages it rests on, the fresh used pages of the package that enter the completeness (format spec 8.8.4, step H11), not every pair of anchors.statement_keys (format spec 10.10.3); the line qualified_time_witness (via time_witness_qualified) or qualified_time_log (via log_day_qualified) stands exactly when qualified_time is not null, directly after the text of the level, with {latest} = qualified_time.latest, {tree_size} = qualified_time.tree_size and {gap} the text gap with gap_ms in whole minutes, rounded down, {h} = M div 60 and {m} = M mod 60 for M = gap_ms in whole minutes, rounded down, both without leading zeros; if both time_witness_qualified and log_day_qualified are missing for level 3, they stand in one line missing_either with the labels and reasons of both, in the place of time_witness_qualified (format spec 10.10.3)

report_objects.comment_de: Berichtsangaben, die keine Befunde sind (Format-Spezifikation 10.10, ab Fassung 1.10): Ort in der JSON-Ausgabe, Member und erzeugte Schemata. Die Membernamen sind für beide Referenz-Verifier normativ.
report_objects.comment_en: Report members that are not findings (format spec 10.10, from edition 1.10): place in the JSON output, members and generated schemas. The member names are normative for both reference verifiers.

path.go: under stats, with the member name
path.verifier2: at the top level, with the member name

report_objects.no_report: an unusable invocation writes no report and none of these objects
report_objects.timestamps: instants the verifier forms itself (from whole milliseconds or from an auditor input, for example requested_at and span) are written as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ; instants from signed objects are copied character for character
report_objects.order: lists of codes follow the registry order; other lists follow the order named at their member
report_objects.completeness_sources_comment: from 1.10 the object completeness (format spec 8.6) carries the member sources: the sources of the found expected roots in this order
report_objects.text_block_comment: summary lines (chain end, completeness, residual window, covered stretches, vendor key list, licence notice); the block of the vendor log; the block of the anchor history; the block of the evidence level, whose last line is the line on affiliation; then keine Befunde. (no findings.) or the findings; with exit 3 the blocks of the vendor log and the anchor history and the line on affiliation are left out

places.comment: the orte of the effective list in the order of the list

vendor_log.not_supplied: status not_supplied; log_id, first_day, key_source, key_list, head, receipts, last_countersigned and logged_roots null; places empty; every count 0, tsa.roots_supplied included, also when roots of purpose log are passed

list.comment: the effective role list; null for a pin

gaps.comment: gaps as ranges [a, b), null for b = infinity, ascending by a

anchor_history.not_supplied: status not_supplied; every count 0, every list empty; issued.first, issued.last, owner, reference_tree_size, predecessor and successor null; coverage {status: none, gaps: []}; completeness {status: not_established, reason: not_supplied, up_to_tree_size: null}; requested_at and the note requested_at_unused follow format spec 10.8

periods.comment: until is the end under format spec 8.8.6 item 4, null only for a period that continues on H*; equal objects (by the bytes of their JCS form) stand once; ascending by from, then until (null last), then the bytes of JCS(bases), then recorded_ts, then merged false before true, then overlaps_package false before true

affiliation.no_used_page: status not_checked or not_determined after format spec 8.8.6 item 2: span, as_of, known_since, stated_by and the three counts null; bases and periods empty; vendor_itself and contradictory false

evidence_level_condition.comment: C: reason is null exactly when the condition is met; up_to_tree_size is null when it is not met; count is 0 when nothing is credited

latest.comment: genTime of the item, truncated to whole milliseconds, written as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ: the state existed at the latest at this time

gap_ms.comment: for log_day_qualified latest minus server_ts of the receipt in whole milliseconds, at most G_q; null for time_witness_qualified

qualified_time.comment: at level 3 at seq 1 the item that proves the qualified time for the state up to up_to_tree_size: candidates are the credited items of time_witness_qualified (TIME_ANCHOR per root) and of log_day_qualified (receipt per time stamp and root) with tree_size >= up_to_tree_size; chosen is the one with the earliest genTime, compared as an instant to the nanosecond like the periods of format spec 10.8, before any cut to whole milliseconds, on a tie time_witness_qualified before log_day_qualified, then the smaller tree_size, then for log_day_qualified the earlier server_ts of the receipt; null below level 3 at seq 1 and outside the state rated (format spec 10.10.2)

statement_keys.comment: without repetition, the pairs of statements key and origin (key_id, public key, origin) of the used pages of the package on which a condition that is met rests: for expected_root_found with the source anchor_history the used pages that carry a recording of a found expected root that is recorded (format spec 8.8.5: recorded_as countersigned or gap_witness); for completeness_from_history, when it is met, every used page that enters the completeness (format spec 8.8.4, step H11), that is the fresh used pages of the package (format spec 8.8.4, older pages); for a page the pair is the one the report names for that page in anchor_history (if it names several, each of them); in the order of anchor_history.keys, each with how it is established (pin, or role list with version, wurzel_id and origin of the root); empty without such a page

stand.comment: written as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ, truncated to whole milliseconds, like every instant from an auditor input (format spec 10.10.1, instants)

quelle.comment: copied as written in the file ledger-tsa-qualifiziert/1

expected_root_sources.comment: in the order auditor, anchor_history, as completeness.sources

evidence_level.not_rated: level, entries, up_to_tree_size, conditions, next, qualified_time and anchors null, segments and notes empty when the state is not rated; affiliation null only in the state format_error

report_objects.origin_names: a pin is pinned in every object; the origin of a root is vendor_root or builtin in key_roles.list.root_source, vendor_log.key_list.root_source and anchor_history.keys[].list.root_source, auditor or builtin in evidence_level.anchors.vendor_keys[].root_from and evidence_level.anchors.statement_keys[].root_from, role_list_auditor_root or role_list_builtin_root in affiliation.stated_by.key_source; vendor_root, auditor and role_list_auditor_root denote the same origin: a vendor root the auditor passed

candidates.comment: the number of distinct role lists (R1)

list.comment: the effective role list Q with the origin of its root (auditor's root or built in); null without Q

statement_keys.comment: the statements keys that can establish pages (pins not dropped and entries of Q with rolle statements), ascending by key_id

listed_as.comment: the role with which a list names the public key: a role from Q, countersigning for K_cs^L, protocol for the protocol key list

pins_dropped.comment: the pins dropped after R3 (d), ascending by key_id

key_roles.not_supplied: status not_supplied without a role list: reason and list null, candidates 0, statement_keys names only pins

license_commitment.comment: SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the license key; the key itself never travels, is never chained and never exported. The commitment is public (every verification package carries it) and proves nothing by itself: possession of the key is proven by license_proof

license_proof.comment: proof of possession of the license key (heartbeat spec 4.1): lowercase hex of HMAC-SHA256 (RFC 2104) keyed with the UTF-8 bytes of the license key over the ASCII bytes of device_pubkey (64 chars) immediately followed by appliance_id (36 chars), exactly as carried in this message (100 bytes, no separator). The server recomputes it with the stored check value of the license key (the key itself or the two SHA-256 chaining values of RFC 2104 section 4, heartbeat spec 4.1), compares in constant time and refuses a different value with 403 license_proof_invalid before anything is registered; a missing value fails the schema with 400 invalid_field (field license_proof). Both regardless of the declared spec_version. Reference values: spec/contract/license_proof.json

spec_version.comment: MAJOR.MINOR of the specification the appliance implements (format spec 10.6); the server accepts every MINOR of its own MAJOR and steers the anchor contract by it (heartbeat spec section 6/9)

activation.license_key_grammar_comment: grammar of the license key itself (heartbeat spec 4.1): at most 29 bytes, uppercase letters, digits and hyphen - never longer than an HMAC-SHA256 block (a longer key would be pre-hashed to exactly the public commitment) and never 64 lowercase hex (it would pass as a commitment into GENESIS); mirrored by the telemetry and the metaserver admin tool

heartbeat.comment: integers, enums and fixed-length hex only; no free-text field exists by construction

spec_version.comment: MAJOR.MINOR of the specification the appliance implements (format spec 10.6); the server accepts every MINOR of its own MAJOR and steers the anchor contract by it (heartbeat spec section 6/9)

anchor.comment: every 5 minutes; the appliance MUST attach consistency_proof (RFC 6962, from the chain's reference size to this tree_size) and the server accepts a grown tree only when the proof verifies; the reference size includes gap witnesses (heartbeat spec 9.2, from 1.8). From spec 1.9 the message contract of spec_version 1.0 without consistency_proof has ended: the server accepts no anchor without it, records nothing for a new chain_id of an appliance that already has a chain with B > 0 without a registered chain succession (409 chain_succession_required), and answers an anchor below B that matches a recorded root or no recorded root as 409 stale_anchor without a fork finding

consistency_proof.comment: since spec_version 1.1 (heartbeat spec section 6/9.2): from_tree_size = the chain's reference size, i.e. the largest tree_size the server countersigned or (from 1.8) recorded as a gap witness (0 = none yet, then hashes is empty); hashes = RFC 6962 consistency proof from from_tree_size to tree_size

cloud_statements.comment_de: Signierte Bescheide des Herstellers in Antworten auf Cloud-Nachrichten (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.4, §9.5, §9.8). Ein Bescheid reist im Antwort-Member license, eine Aktivierungsquittung im Antwort-Member activation_receipt, jeweils als Objekt aus statement (unsignierte Lesekopie, vom Empfänger zu ignorieren), statement_jcs, server_key_id und server_signature. Signiert sind allein die UTF-8-Bytes von statement_jcs (JCS, RFC 8785), mit dem Schlüssel server_key_id: ab Fassung 1.10 ein Bescheidschlüssel (Rolle statements, Format-Spezifikation 10.7.3); bis zum Ende des Doppelbetriebs trägt die Hülle von Lizenzbescheid, Verweigerungsbescheid und Aktivierungsquittung das Paar eines Gegenzeichnungsschlüssels und das Antwort-Member statement_signatures das Paar eines Bescheidschlüssels über denselben statement_jcs (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.3, §9.11). Ein Bescheid ist nur wirksam, wenn statement_jcs I-JSON und genau die JCS-Form seines Inhalts ist, die Member genau die hier genannten sind, der Schlüssel zu server_ts gültig ist, die Signatur trägt und license_commitment das eigene ist. Bescheide ändern nie die Aufzeichnung; Verifier werten sie nicht aus, ausgenommen ab Fassung 1.10 Seiten der Anker-Historie der Form v2, die der Prüfer übergibt (Format-Spezifikation 8.8, Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.7). statement_jcs ist höchstens 2048 Zeichen lang, außer eine Art nennt eine eigene Grenze statement_jcs_maxlen (ab Fassung 1.10 allein anchor_history_v2 mit 131072 Zeichen druckbaren ASCII). Referenzwerte: spec/contract/.
cloud_statements.comment_en: Signed vendor statements in responses to cloud messages (heartbeat spec 9.4, 9.5, 9.8). A statement travels in the response member license, an activation receipt in the response member activation_receipt, each as an object of statement (unsigned reading copy, to be ignored by the recipient), statement_jcs, server_key_id and server_signature. Only the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs (JCS, RFC 8785) are signed, with the key server_key_id: from edition 1.10 a statements key (role statements, format spec 10.7.3); until the end of dual operation the wrapper of licence statement, refusal and activation receipt carries the pair of a countersigning key and the response member statement_signatures the pair of a statements key over the same statement_jcs (heartbeat spec 9.3, 9.11). A statement is effective only if statement_jcs is I-JSON and exactly the JCS form of its content, its members are exactly those listed here, the key is valid at server_ts, the signature holds and license_commitment is the recipient's own. Statements never change recording; verifiers do not evaluate them, except from edition 1.10 anchor history pages of kind v2 that the auditor passes (format spec 8.8, heartbeat spec 9.7). statement_jcs has at most 2048 characters unless a kind names its own limit statement_jcs_maxlen (from edition 1.10 anchor_history_v2 alone, with 131072 characters of printable ASCII). Reference values: spec/contract/.

statement_jcs.comment: the statement in JCS form (RFC 8785); only these UTF-8 bytes are signed; at most 2048 characters unless the kind names its own statement_jcs_maxlen (anchor_history_v2: 131072)

server_key_id.comment: a key of role statements (format spec 10.7.3); until ende_doppelbetrieb the wrapper of licence statement, refusal and activation receipt and pages of kind v1 carry a countersigning key (format spec 10.7.5); key_id grammar of format spec 10.7.1

server_signature.comment: Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs

license_statement.comment: in the 200 responses to activation and heartbeat (heartbeat spec 9.3, 9.4); display only

countersigning.comment: true exactly when state is not expired; a contradiction makes the statement ineffective

updates.comment: entitlement to feature updates; in spec 1.8 equal to countersigning; security fixes do not depend on it (decision 2026-09-29)

valid_until.comment: null for a license without a term

grace_until.comment: null for a license without a term

anchor_refusal.comment: in the 403 license_expired response to anchor (heartbeat spec 9.5): the vendor checked this anchor (9.2 steps 1-4), stored it as a gap witness and does not countersign it. The appliance treats the 403 as a license lock only if the statement is effective, appliance_id is its own, chain_id/tree_size/merkle_root are exactly those of the anchor this request sent and server_ts is within 15 minutes of its clock. Not a countersignature: never chained as CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT

activation_receipt.comment: in every 200 answer to an activation (heartbeat spec 9.3, 9.8, from 1.9): the registration of appliance_id with device_pubkey is held under license_commitment at server_ts; a statement of state, not bound to one request; required with the licence statement to accept a rebinding (4.1)

license_commitment.comment: the commitment the vendor holds this registration under at server_ts

anchor_history.comment: the signed anchor history of one chain (heartbeat spec 9.7, from spec 1.9): GET /v1/anchors?chain_id=<uuid>[&since_tree_size=n], no login, no personal data; every root the server recorded (countersigned, gap_witness) or received device-signed without accepting it (reported: heartbeat last_checkpoint, anchors answered with consistency_required). The auditor fetches it himself and passes every root recorded before the package was requested as an expected root (format spec 8.6, 10.8, 11.2). From spec 1.10 verifiers do not read pages of this kind (reason not_v2); the auditor passes pages of kind anchor_history_v2 to the verifier instead (format spec 8.8), and for v1 pages the manual procedure stays (heartbeat spec 9.7)

predecessor.comment: registered chain succession: the predecessor chain and the tree_size handed over there

successor.comment: registered successor: its chain_id and the tree_size handed over from this chain (the end of this chain)

anchor_history.key: until ende_doppelbetrieb byte for byte under a countersigning key, afterwards under a statements key (heartbeat spec 9.7, 9.11); once a role list is published, an auditor after edition 1.10 never passes roots from these pages as expected roots (heartbeat spec 9.7)

anchor_history_v2.comment: the signed anchor history of one chain, kind v2 (heartbeat spec 9.7, 9.10, from spec 1.10): GET /v1/anchors?chain_id=<uuid>&kind=ledger.anchor_history.v2[&since_tree_size=n]; the members of v1 plus owner_keys, forks_omitted, next_since_tree_size and affiliation; statement_jcs is printable ASCII (0x20 to 0x7E) of at most 131072 characters, every instant exactly YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ except server_ts in roots, which is the stored character string (from 1.10 in the same form, for a root recorded earlier as the server wrote it then); read by verifiers from 1.10 as an auditor input (format spec 8.8, 10.8)

owner_keys.comment: owner commitments, one per device key of the appliance the chain belongs to; strictly ascending

predecessor.comment: registered chain succession as in v1

server_ts.comment: the stored character string of the countersignature or recording (heartbeat spec 9.7 duty 6); from 1.10 written as YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sssZ, for a root recorded earlier as the server wrote it then; page rules compare instants in whole milliseconds

forks_omitted.comment: number of fork findings in the range of the page it does not list (signed omission marker)

next_since_tree_size.comment: since_tree_size of the next page and exclusive upper bound of this page's range; null if and only if truncated is false

bases.comment: strictly ascending codes of heartbeat spec 9.10

affiliation.comment: affiliation of the customer with the vendor after heartbeat spec 9.10, as of server_ts; JCS order known_since, periods; in a period bases, from, merged, recorded_ts, until

server_ts.comment: issue time, taken after every read for the page

page_rules: next_since_tree_size is null if and only if truncated is false; else it is greater than since_tree_size and than every tree_size of the page
every tree_size in roots and forks lies in the range of the page
roots ascend strictly by tree_size, then server_ts, then recorded_as in the order countersigned, gap_witness, reported, then merkle_root, pairwise distinct by (tree_size, merkle_root, recorded_as)
forks ascend strictly by tree_size, then detected_ts, then merkle_root, pairwise distinct by (tree_size, merkle_root)
no server_ts of a root and no detected_ts lies after the server_ts of the page
reference_tree_size is at least every tree_size of a root with recorded_as countersigned or gap_witness
predecessor.chain_id and successor.chain_id differ from chain_id and from each other
owner_keys ascend strictly (lowercase hex) and have 1 to 16 entries
known_since, if not null, does not lie after server_ts

periods: bases not empty, strictly ascending, only codes of heartbeat spec 9.10; from before server_ts; recorded_ts not after server_ts; until, if not null, after from and not after server_ts; only the last period MAY have until null; ordered by from and not overlapping; two adjoining periods differ in their bases
anchor_history_v2.page_rules_finding: ANCHOR_HISTORY_CONTRADICTION, reason page_rules (format spec 8.8.4, H2 item 5)

owner_commitment.appliance_id: the appliance the chain belongs to (the server's binding, heartbeat spec 9.2 step 1; for a chain known only through a registered succession, the appliance of that succession)
owner_commitment.device_pubkey: a device key the server registered for this appliance (device key journal)

server_duties.without_kind: the v1 form byte for byte as in 1.9
server_duties.no_owner_key: HTTP 409 owner_key_unknown and an alarm, never a page with an empty owner_keys
server_duties.whole_tree_sizes: all roots and fork findings of one tree_size stand on the same page; next_since_tree_size = the greatest tree_size of the page plus 1
server_duties.owner_roots: every root of a page comes from a message of the appliance the chain belongs to; a reported root whose sender the server can no longer determine is listed on no page
server_duties.rate_limit: per source address and per pair of chain_id and source address, so that from one address ten chain years of one chain can be fetched in one hour (about 2300 pages), above that HTTP 429 rate_limited to this address; no limit that hits all senders of a chain_id together; counters in memory only
server_duties.statements_key: pages of this kind are offered only once a statements key stands in a published role list, and are signed only with a statements key (heartbeat spec 9.7 duty 10, 9.11)

example.comment: the page with the vector's two countersigned roots (tree_size 15 at 2026-01-01T00:30:01.000Z and 28 at 2026-01-01T01:00:01.000Z), the owner commitment above, known_since 2025-12-01T00:00:00.000Z, no periods, reference_tree_size 28, since_tree_size 0, no continuation and server_ts 2026-01-01T01:02:00.000Z (format spec 8.8.2)

cloud_response_members.comment_de: Unsignierte Member von Antworten auf Cloud-Nachrichten (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.3). Sie sind Hinweise, keine Beweise: Die Appliance leitet aus ihnen keine Entscheidung ab, die Aufzeichnung, Kette oder Verankerung betrifft; ein Hinweis, der seinem Schema nicht entspricht, wird verworfen. Ab Fassung 1.10 kommt statement_signatures hinzu: kein Hinweis, sondern das zweite Paar jedes Bescheids derselben Antwort unter einem Bescheidschlüssel (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.3); für es gelten die Regeln in seinem Eintrag.
cloud_response_members.comment_en: Unsigned members of responses to cloud messages (heartbeat spec 9.3). They are notices, not evidence: the appliance derives from them no decision that concerns recording, the chain or anchoring; a notice that does not match its schema is discarded. From edition 1.10 statement_signatures is added: not a notice but the second pair of every statement of the same response under a statements key (heartbeat spec 9.3); the rules in its entry apply to it.

update.comment: heartbeat 200 member 'update' (from spec 1.9): announces an update bundle; unsigned; the bundle is installed only after its signature against the pinned update key holds, with the customer's consent and never as a downgrade (heartbeat spec 1, 9.3)

sha256.comment: SHA-256 over the whole bundle file; transport integrity only, not authenticity; since the addition of 2026-10-07 it names the amd64 bundle

update_arch.comment: heartbeat 200 member 'update_arch' (from spec 1.9, addition of 2026-10-07): SHA-256 of the bundle per architecture; present exactly when 'update' is and taken only together with it; a malformed one discards the whole notice; unsigned, transport integrity only; the updater fetches <source>/<version>/ledger-<version>-<architecture>.rbundle and nothing without its own architecture (heartbeat spec 1, 9.3)

amd64.comment: SHA-256 over the whole bundle for amd64 (x86_64)

arm64.comment: SHA-256 over the whole bundle for arm64 (aarch64)

statement_signatures.comment: optional top-level response member (heartbeat spec 9.3, from edition 1.10): one member per statement of the same response, named like that response member; each carries exactly server_key_id and server_signature of a statements key over the UTF-8 bytes of that statement's statement_jcs; the wrapper of the statement (heartbeat spec 9.4) keeps its four members; this schema shows the well-formed member: a receiver after 1.10 does not refuse a response that deviates from it but follows the rules in malformed

server_signature.comment: Ed25519 (RFC 8032, no prehash, no context) by a key of role statements over the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs of the statement of the same name
Ed25519 (RFC 8032, no prehash, no context) by a key of role statements over the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs of the statement of the same name

statement_signatures.duty: until ende_doppelbetrieb the wrapper pair is a countersigning key and the server MUST send statement_signatures; afterwards a statements key signs the wrapper and statement_signatures MAY be missing; receivers after 1.10 accept both forms (format spec 10.7.5, heartbeat spec 9.11)
statement_signatures.older_receivers: receivers of edition 1.9 do not know the member and ignore it (heartbeat spec 9)
malformed: statement_signatures that is not an object, or a member of it that is not an object of exactly these two strings in their grammar: that pair is ignored and the statement is judged on its remaining pairs (heartbeat spec 9.4 item 3)
a member that names no statement of the response is ignored
duplicate member names anywhere in the response: not I-JSON, an ordinary failure
statement_signatures.receiver_rule: a receiver after 1.10 checks the wrapper pair and the pair in statement_signatures; the statement is effective only if at least one of them names a key of role statements that is valid at server_ts (after its role list, format spec 10.7.2, or as a statements key pinned at installation) and its signature holds; a pair under a key of another role never counts, not even as a fallback (heartbeat spec 9.4 item 3)

object_kinds.comment_de: Jeder Wert des Members kind, den diese Spezifikation vergibt, mit Rolle und Schlüssel (ab Fassung 1.10). Kein Objekt, das ein Schlüssel des Herstellers signiert, hat den Signaturgegenstand eines anderen: Die Gegensignatur hat genau die vier Member aus Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.1 ohne kind, jedes andere Objekt ein kind mit dem Wert seiner Art (Heartbeat-Spezifikation §9.4). Rollen des Objekts: signed (signiertes Objekt), leaf (Blatt des Herstellerprotokolls, nur gehasht), hash_input (Eingabe eines Hashwerts), hmac_input (Nachricht einer Ableitung mit HMAC-SHA-256). key nennt die Rolle des Schlüssels, der das Objekt signiert (Format-Spezifikation 10.7.3); dual_operation_key nennt die Rolle des Schlüssels, der es bis zum Ende des Doppelbetriebs signiert (Format-Spezifikation 10.7.5).
object_kinds.comment_en: Every value of the member kind this specification assigns, with role and key (from edition 1.10). No object a vendor key signs has the signing subject of another: the countersignature has exactly the four members of heartbeat spec 9.1 without kind, every other object a kind with the value of its sort (heartbeat spec 9.4). Roles of the object: signed (signed object), leaf (leaf of the vendor log, hashed only), hash_input (input of a hash value), hmac_input (message of a derivation with HMAC-SHA-256). key names the role of the key that signs the object (format spec 10.7.3); dual_operation_key names the role of the key that signs it until the end of dual operation (format spec 10.7.5).

license_statement.dual_operation_comment: until ende_doppelbetrieb the wrapper pair is a countersigning key and the pair in the response member statement_signatures a statements key, both over the same statement_jcs (heartbeat spec 9.3, 9.4); the same holds for anchor_refusal and activation_receipt

anchor_history.dual_operation_comment: pages of kind v1 stay byte for byte under a countersigning key until ende_doppelbetrieb and then move to a statements key (heartbeat spec 9.7, 9.11)

anchor_history_v2.dual_operation_comment: statements key only, also during dual operation; a page under a key of another role establishes nothing (format spec 8.8.3)

update_manifest.refused: kept as defence in depth: a configured manifest that itself carries a member kind or exactly the four members of the countersignature (chain_id, merkle_root, server_ts, tree_size) is refused, and nothing is signed
update_manifest.custody: signed only by a key of role update_manifest, at release; no running service holds that key, and the server serves the stored signature; no server signs a configured manifest with a countersigning key, in any phase (heartbeat spec 9.4, 9.11)

stored_form.statement_jcs: string, the envelope in JCS form, I-JSON without duplicate member names; only these bytes are signed
stored_form.server_key_id: string, ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$, the key_id of the manifest key
stored_form.server_signature: hex128, Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs
stored_form.comment: stored at release; GET /v1/update-manifest answers with exactly the stored bytes; the same three members as entry of a day of the vendor log (heartbeat spec 9.9), without a reading copy

server_duties.check: before every delivery: statement_jcs is the JCS form of an object with exactly the members kind and manifest, kind is ledger.update_manifest.v1, manifest is an object without a member kind and not with exactly the four members of a countersignature, and the signature holds under a key that the role list the server works from (heartbeat spec 9.11 item 6) names as valid with role update_manifest at the time of the request
server_duties.no_manifest: HTTP 404 no_manifest while no envelope signed with a manifest key is stored
server_duties.manifest_unavailable: HTTP 503 manifest_unavailable and an alarm when the stored envelope fails the check; its bytes are never delivered

update_manifest.comment: GET /v1/update-manifest; the envelope is the signing subject, stored_form is what is stored and delivered

vendor_log_day_leaf.comment: the kind of every leaf of the day tree, a chain-day leaf or a filler; it says nothing about the origin of the leaf (format spec 7.4.3, 7.4.4)

duty_mapping.comment_de: Sprachregel verbindlich: jede Kachel sagt „unterstützt die Erfüllung“, nie „erfüllt“. Wo LEDGER keinen Beleg erzeugt, sagt die Kachel ehrlich „kein Beleg durch LEDGER“. Adressat einer Pflicht ist der Anbieter oder der Betreiber des KI-Systems (VO (EU) 2024/1689); bei Pflichten des Anbieters eines fremden Systems erzeugt LEDGER beim Betreiber keinen Beleg.
duty_mapping.comment_en: Binding language rule: every tile says 'supports fulfilment', never 'fulfils'. Where LEDGER produces no evidence, the tile honestly says 'no evidence produced by LEDGER'. The addressee of a duty is the provider or the deployer of the AI system (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689); for duties of the provider of a third-party system LEDGER produces no evidence at the deployer.

protokollaufbewahrung.honest_limit_de: Das Format legt keine Aufbewahrungsfrist fest und prüft keine; gelöscht werden nur Inhalte im Tresor (CONTENT_DELETED), nie Einträge der Kette; ein einzelner verlorener Aufruf ist im Prüfpaket offline nicht zu erkennen (Format-Spezifikation 11.2).
protokollaufbewahrung.honest_limit_en: The format sets no retention period and checks none; only vault contents are deleted (CONTENT_DELETED), never chain entries; a single lost call cannot be recognised offline in the verification package (format specification 11.2).
protokollaufbewahrung.legal_basis_de: Art. 12 Abs. 1 und Art. 19 Abs. 1 (Anbieter); Art. 26 Abs. 6 (Betreiber)

aufsichts_nachweis.legal_basis_de: Art. 12 Abs. 3 lit. d (Anbieter); Art. 26 Abs. 5 (Betreiber, Überwachen)

betriebsueberwachung.legal_basis_de: Art. 12 Abs. 2 lit. c (Anbieter); Art. 26 Abs. 5 (Betreiber, Überwachen)

transparenzbelege.honest_limit_de: LEDGER belegt erzeugte Berichte und Aufruf-Metadaten; Endnutzer-Transparenz (Kennzeichnungspflichten) erzeugt LEDGER nicht. Für die Transparenzpflichten des Anbieters (Art. 13, Art. 50 Abs. 1 und 2): kein Beleg durch LEDGER.
transparenzbelege.honest_limit_en: LEDGER evidences issued reports and call metadata; it does not produce end-user transparency (labelling) itself. For the transparency duties of the provider (Art. 13, Art. 50(1) and (2)): no evidence produced by LEDGER.
transparenzbelege.legal_basis_de: Art. 50 Abs. 3 und 4, Art. 26 Abs. 7 und 11, Art. 86 (Betreiber)

zweckbindung.honest_limit_de: Belegt sind deklarierter Systemzweck (Genesis) und dessen Änderungen sowie Anbieter-/Modell-Konstanz; eine inhaltliche Zweckprüfung findet nicht statt.
zweckbindung.honest_limit_en: Evidenced are the declared system purpose (genesis), its changes, and provider/model constancy; no substantive purpose assessment takes place.
zweckbindung.legal_basis_de: Art. 12 Abs. 2 lit. a (Anbieter, nur Änderungen)

meldung_aussetzung.honest_limit_de: Kein Beleg durch LEDGER: Für die Information von Anbieter oder Händler und Marktüberwachungsbehörde und für das Aussetzen der Nutzung gibt es keinen Eintragstyp. Das Überwachen des Betriebs belegt die Zeile Betriebsüberwachung.
meldung_aussetzung.honest_limit_en: No evidence produced by LEDGER: there is no entry type for informing the provider or distributor and the market surveillance authority or for suspending use. Monitoring of operation is evidenced by the row operational monitoring.

beobachtungsdaten.honest_limit_de: Belegt sind Metadaten jedes Aufrufs (Zeit, Modell, Ergebnis, Dauer, Größen und Token-Zahlen) und erzeugte Berichte; ein System zur Beobachtung nach dem Inverkehrbringen, seine Auswertung und die Weitergabe an den Anbieter erzeugt LEDGER nicht.
beobachtungsdaten.honest_limit_en: Evidenced are the metadata of every call (time, model, outcome, duration, sizes and token counts) and issued reports; LEDGER does not produce a post-market monitoring system, its analysis or the transfer to the provider.
beobachtungsdaten.legal_basis_de: Art. 12 Abs. 2 lit. b und Art. 72 (Anbieter)

biometrie_abgleich.de: Protokoll biometrischer Fernidentifizierung (Referenzdatenbank, Eingaben mit Treffer)
biometrie_abgleich.en: Remote biometric identification log (reference database, input data with a match)
biometrie_abgleich.honest_limit_de: Kein Beleg durch LEDGER: LEDGER hält weder die Referenzdatenbank fest, gegen die Eingaben abgeglichen wurden, noch die Eingabedaten, die zu einem Treffer führten.
biometrie_abgleich.honest_limit_en: No evidence produced by LEDGER: LEDGER records neither the reference database against which input data was checked nor the input data that led to a match.
biometrie_abgleich.legal_basis_de: Art. 12 Abs. 3 lit. b und c, Anhang III Nr. 1 lit. a (Anbieter)

testvectors.comment: Each vector = directory spec/testvectors/<name>/ with package files + spec/testvectors/expected/<name>.json {exit_code, finding_classes:[...]} . Crypto-valid bytes are generated by the ledger vector generator and then frozen (hash pin in spec/testvectors/PINS.sha256). From spec 1.4 the expectations hold for the audit environment spec/testvectors/pruefer_herstellerwurzel.json (--vendor-root) and pruefer_herstellerschluessel.txt (--vendor-key): the vendor keys of a receipt are established by the auditor's anchors, not by the package (format spec 7.1, 10.7). From spec 1.6 (format spec 8.6) every vector that is not a format error is also judged on its chain end: all vectors frozen up to 1.5 end without a seal, like an export from a running installation, and are therefore incomplete (UNSEALED_END, exit 4). Their bytes are unchanged; only the expectation follows the released edition 1.6 (precedent: spec 1.1, format_unknown_event_type). The group 'end' holds the chain-end cases of edition 1.6. From spec 1.7 the group 'hold' holds the legal-hold cases (format spec 4.24, 9.3); its chains are sealed, so their verdict shows the hold rule alone. From spec 1.8 the group 'license' holds the licence-commitment cases (format spec 4.1): GENESIS.license_id is the commitment from the GENESIS entry's own spec_version 1.8 on, a 1.8 GENESIS with the key in cleartext is FORMAT_ERROR, and a GENESIS of 1.7 keeps its cleartext with a notice (no finding); its chains are sealed, so their verdict shows the licence rule alone. From spec 1.9 the group 'export' holds the export-seal cases (format spec 4.10, 8.4, 8.6); the covered late immediate checkpoint (8.2 conditions 3 and 4) extends 'gap' and 'tamper', and four clarifications both verifiers used to read differently (10.1 segment path and presented plaintexts, 2 integer range, 10.5 processing stages) extend 'tamper' and 'format'. From spec 1.10 an expected file may also carry evidence_level and auditor_inputs (registry expected_files); the bytes, exit codes and finding classes of the frozen vectors stay unchanged. From spec 1.10 the groups 'roles' (key roles, format spec 10.7.2 to 10.7.5), 'auditor' (auditor inputs, 10.8, 10.7.4) and 'timestamp' (time-stamp profile and time witnesses, 7.3, 7.5) hold vectors whose second audit environment is the file spec/testvectors/pruefer_<name>.json (ledger-pruefumgebung/1, 10.8) with the files it names; their entries carry evidence_level (corpus environment) and auditor_inputs (that environment), and member why names the reason and the deciding section. auditor_inputs with exit_code 3 and no finding classes is an unusable invocation, which writes no report (10.8) and has no evidence level (10.9.2, 10.10.1): its evidence_level is null; the object of state format_error stands only where a format error writes a report (FORMAT_ERROR, exit 3). From spec 1.10 the group 'log' (vendor log, format spec 7.4.10 steps L0 to L10, report object vendor_log of 10.10.2) holds vectors whose packages carry their own chain and whose second audit environment passes extracts of the test log ledger-testprotokoll-1 (format spec 7.4.4, 7.4.5, 7.4.7) with --vendor-log; like the groups 'roles', 'auditor' and 'timestamp' their entries carry evidence_level, auditor_inputs and why. A day time stamp of an authority whose keys come from published seeds (verifier.timestamp_profile.published_test_keys) is never confirmed, so with such authorities no day of the test log is witnessed and no vector shows the classes that need a usable day. The corpus MAY contain a time-stamping authority with discarded keys (format spec 7.5.7): its keys are created in one run of the generator from a cryptographically secure random source, issue the corpus tokens only in that run and are written nowhere; its root and certificates are in the corpus, its keys are not in published_test_keys, and it counts only where a vector's audit environment passes its root (pruefer_<name>.json); no auditor outside the corpus has a reason to pass it. Its tokens cannot be issued again: the generator keeps them as frozen inputs and refuses to run if a regenerated statement no longer matches a frozen token; a new set of such tokens needs a new authority with a new root and new pins. Whoever ran the generator could have kept the key, so such a root is never an auditor's root. The corpus contains three such authorities, E1, E2 and E3. E1: its certificates and tokens are the frozen input appliance/cmd/vektorgen/eingefroren/zeitstempelstelle_e1.json, copied byte for byte to spec/testvectors/zeitstempelstelle_e1.json and pinned; its root (SPKI SHA-256 596a543ec10239b2d08e7230b38b4e5bac7531758c9b83a3d75c59acc7c604ac) is passed with --vendor-log-tsa-root, and where a vector is about condition 4 or 7 also in --tsa-qualified-roots, by the vectors log_witnessed_* and log_receipt_invalid_outside_range of the group log, which show the classes and findings that need a usable day (spec/testvectors/README 11.2, 11.3).
